本周核心方向（ML × ferro / 凝聚态）

20 篇

本周新材料主线最亮眼的是机器学习引导发现的 Y-Mn-B 富锰硼化物：作者从超过 10⁶ 个假想结构中筛出稳定、近稳定与亚稳相，且部分 Mn 链相保留较大局域磁矩并偏好铁磁有序，说明一维硼化物里通过过渡金属替换可以重新激活磁性。另一条新材料线集中在交替磁与关联氧化物：α-MnTe 薄膜已能外延长在绝缘体、拓扑绝缘体、过渡金属硫属化物和 Fe3GeTe2 等多类衬底上，CoF2 中则用共振弹性 X 射线散射直接确认反铁四极有序，而 Ag2BiO3 的中心对称金属相被证明是动力学不稳定的，氧八面体呼吸畸变会把它推向带有配体空穴的 Pnn2 键歧化绝缘体。新现象方面，少层 WTe2 在室温下实现了铁电可切换的量子几何，二阶和三阶 NLAHE 可在约 10⁴ 次循环与约 10⁵ s 保持时间内协同翻转，并进一步做出 98% 纹理识别的互补卷积核。新方法线索非常密集：AIMD 轨迹上的材料特异性 MLIP 研究给出 10/200/2000 构型三个量级的经验阈值，指出同样数据下从头训练常可与朴素微调竞争。带电点缺陷的多保真势通过全局缺陷电荷嵌入结合半局域与杂化泛函数据，直接把缺陷热力学和稳定结构做到了量子化学一致。数据基础设施与大规模模拟也在推进：ChemReporter 试图把异构化学数据统一成可查询、可子采样的 Parquet 仓库，另一项小占用 MLIP 把 HBM 压到现有方法的 3% 以下，使多组分块体 MD 只需数百块 GPU 即可开展。输运与动力学方面，图神经网络把含氦泡和晶界的钨直接映射为任意温度下的 D_H(T) 与 κ(T) 张量，纳米晶硅工作则把 MLIP、Phonopy/Phono3py 和 NEMD 串成一体来量化声子寿命、热导率和晶界热边界电阻。

  1. 01
    通过先进机器学习引导框架发现新型磁性 Y-Mn-B 化合物
    Discovery of novel magnetic Y-Mn-B compounds via advanced machine learning guided framework
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：arXiv:2608.17200v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：稀土-过渡金属硼化物为永磁体设计提供关键结构基元；然而，这些成分相空间中的富锰区域仍基本未被探索。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种先进的机器学习辅助发现框架，用于探索 Y-Mn-B 三元体系。我们从数据库中已知结构生成的一百多万个假想结构出发，首先应用图神经网络预测材料稳定性以筛选有前景的候选物，随后使用机器学习原子间势弛豫其结构，最后用第一性原理计算验证结果。我们识别出 5 个稳定和近稳定的 Y-Mn-B 相，以及 61 个相对于三元凸包形成能在 100 meV/原子以内的亚稳化合物。其中，Y2Mn7B7 和 YMn4B4 在结构上类似于先前合成的 R₁₊ϵFe₄B₄ 一维非公度复合链化合物。与报道中强烈受抑制的 Fe 磁矩形成鲜明对比，我们的第一性原理计算显示，预测的 Mn 链相保留了可观的局域 Mn 磁矩（约 1.1 μ_B），并偏好铁磁有序。电子结构分析阐明了磁矩恢复的微观起源，即由类似 Stoner 不稳定性驱动的增强交换劈裂。我们还进行了系统的 Mn-Fe 替换，以确认从 Fe 到 Mn 的热力学连续性以及宏观磁化强度的单调增强。这些发现表明，在一维硼化物家族内进行有目标的过渡金属替换可以恢复过渡金属磁性，为设计新的磁性稀土-过渡金属硼化物提供了一条物理上可解释的路径。

    📐 方法要点：从逾百万个 Y-Mn-B 假想结构出发，先用图神经网络筛选候选，再用机器学习原子间势做结构弛豫，最后以第一性原理复核稳定性与磁性。重点搜索富锰区域，锁定稳定、近稳定和亚稳相。

    🔗 相关工作关联：呼应了高通量计算与 ML-guided 材料发现，但把筛选对象从能量稳定性扩展到磁矩保留与铁磁序。与常见硼化物搜索相比，这里更强调一维 Mn 链中的局域磁性恢复。

    💡 对你方向的启示：可把同类流程迁移到其他过渡金属硼化物或碳化物体系，优先查找“局域磁矩+低维骨架”的组合。候选排序时不只看形成能，也应把磁矩、交换偏好和近稳定性一起纳入。

    阅读原文 ↗
  2. 02
    从从头算分子动力学轨迹高数据效率构建材料特异性机器学习原子间势
    Data-Efficient Construction of Material-Specific Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials from Ab Initio Molecular Dynamics Trajectories
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：预训练机器学习原子间势，即所谓通用模型或基础模型，为原子模拟提供了有吸引力的起点，但如果没有额外参考数据（微调），它们对材料特异性可观测量的精度往往仍然有限。在这里，我们系统量化需要多少第一性原理数据才能将通用模型转化为具有从头算精度的材料特异性势，并询问微调是否必然优于从头训练。我们比较了五种通用 MLIP 框架，即 MACE-MP-0、SevenNet-0、GRACE-1L-OAM、MatterSim-v1-5M 和 ORB-v2，涵盖七个化学多样体系，并纳入稀有和反应性事件。仅用 10 个 AIMD 衍生构型进行微调对所研究体系而言是不够的；200 个构型在有利情况下可以成功，但结果仍强烈依赖体系。相比之下，2000 个 AIMD 构型构成了稳健的默认选择，能够产生较低的力和能量误差，并再现目标材料特异性可观测量。对 AIMD 轨迹进行中等密度子采样可将所需轨迹长度减少十倍，而模型质量损失很小。在相同数据集上从头训练与 MACE 和 SevenNet 的朴素微调具有竞争力，并且往往略微更准确，而 GRACE 需要更多数据。MoS₂ 中硫空位跃迁的能量剖面显示，低轨迹层面误差并不能保证正确的反应剖面，这凸显了可观测量层面验证的必要性。最后，我们表明，在数据稀缺情形下，对独立训练模型进行平均可以在不增加第一性原理成本的情况下改善预测。综合来看，这些结果为将有限 AIMD 参考数据转化为可靠的材料特异性 MLIP 提供了实用指南，使其可用于接近 DFT 精度的纳秒时间尺度模拟。

    📐 方法要点：系统比较五种通用 MLIP 框架在七类化学体系中的微调与从头训练，训练数据量从 10 到 2000 个 AIMD 构型逐级测试。作者强调应在目标可观测量层面验证模型，而不只看损失函数。

    🔗 相关工作关联：延续了通用预训练势向材料特异势迁移的思路，但直接给出数据量阈值：10 个通常不够，200 个只在有利情况下可行，2000 个更稳健。结果也提醒微调不一定优于从头训练。

    💡 对你方向的启示：实际做新体系 MLIP 时，可先用小规模 AIMD 快速试训，再按 200、2000 构型两档评估是否需要继续补数据。若目标是缺陷、相变或高温性质，优先用力、应力和相关热力学量做外部检验。

    阅读原文 ↗
  3. 03
    Graph neural network prediction of temperature-dependent hydrogen diffusion and thermal conductivity tensors of tungsten containing helium bubbles and grain boundaries
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：arXiv:2608.15609v1 公告类型：新 摘要：钨等离子体面对元件中的氦泡和晶界会使氢同位素输运和热传导改变几个数量级，但针对给定微结构评估这些输运性质时，每种构型都需要数小时的分子动力学（MD）计算。我们提出一种图神经网络替代模型，可将含氦泡和晶界的钨原子构型直接映射为任意温度下氢扩散系数 D_H(T) 和热导率 κ(T) 的完整 3×3 对称张量。各向异性通过旋转等变的张量池化层加以捕捉；温度则通过预测的与温度无关参数（Arrhenius 参数对 (D₀, Eₐ)、声子热导张量以及缺陷剩余电阻率）引入，并借助 Arrhenius 关系和 Wiedemann-Franz-Matthiessen 关系进行解析展开。635 个微结构的训练标签由嵌入原子方法势函数生成（Green-Kubo 热导率和多温度示踪扩散）；电子通道通过已发表的辐照退化测量进行标定，整个流程则借助配对的 MD 标定运行和主动学习循环，通过第一性原理机器学习势（VASP+FLARE）进行锚定。学习得到的活化能（中位数 0.21 eV，在气泡和晶界结构中升高）再现了文献中的氢迁移势垒和俘获物理，而等变池化保证了在任意取向子块之间预测的一致性。由该替代模型驱动的耦合有限元热-氢分析表明，导热率退化会通过温度场使预测的氢渗透变化 2.5 倍。该模型可在毫秒级同时返回两个张量，为聚变偏滤器的部件尺度分析提供微结构分辨的输运输入。

    📐 方法要点：用旋转等变的张量池化层，把含氦泡和晶界的钨微结构直接映射为任意温度下的 D_H(T) 与 κ(T) 的 3×3 对称张量。温度依赖通过拟合 Arrhenius 参数、声子热导张量和缺陷剩余电阻率，再结合 Arrhenius 关系与 Wiedemann–Franz–Matthiessen 关系展开。

    🔗 相关工作关联：把微结构到输运的映射从标量提升到完整张量，适合各向异性缺陷主导的核材料问题。与常规 MD 相比，它把数小时一例的计算压缩成一次前向预测。

    💡 对你方向的启示：若要研究辐照钨中的氢滞留或热扩散，可先用该类张量模型筛查微结构，再对最敏感构型做精细 MD。对其他金属缺陷体系，也可复用“结构编码+解析温度展开”的组合。

    阅读原文 ↗
  4. 04
    用于带电点缺陷的多保真机器学习原子间势
    Multi-fidelity Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials for Charged Point Defects
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：与第一性原理计算相比，机器学习原子间势现在已经能够高精度再现体相材料的能量、力和应力。对缺陷的描述仍然是一个挑战，因为在缺陷中，配位环境和电子数会偏离完美参考结构中的情况。我们发现，当前一代基础机器学习原子间势不能描述半导体 Sb₂Se₃ 的缺陷物理。我们引入全局缺陷电荷嵌入，以区分不同电荷态的成键特征。我们进一步采用一种多保真方法，将低成本的半局域交换-关联泛函参考数据与高质量的非局域杂化泛函能量和力相结合，后者能够很好地描述缺陷能量景观的细微特征。由此得到的具备缺陷描述能力的力场可以找到稳定结构构型，并预测与直接量子力学计算定量一致的缺陷热力学，而计算成本仅为其一小部分。

    📐 方法要点：在基础 MLIP 中引入全局缺陷电荷嵌入，用来区分 Sb2Se3 中不同电荷态缺陷的成键差异。训练上采用多保真策略，把低成本半局域数据与高质量杂化泛函能量、力联合使用。

    🔗 相关工作关联：对应了半导体缺陷建模中“电荷态敏感、局域环境变化大”的老问题，但这里把电荷信息显式写进势函数。相较单一保真训练，它更适合处理稳定缺陷结构与缺陷热力学。

    💡 对你方向的启示：研究带电缺陷时，可把“电荷嵌入+多保真”作为默认设计，而不是指望无电荷信息的通用势自动外推。若体系存在明显电子数偏离，应优先补充高质量少量标注，而不是盲目扩大低保真数据。

    阅读原文 ↗
  5. 05
    ChemReporter: A Framework for Curating and Exporting Large-Scale Chemical Datasets for MLIP Training
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：arXiv:2608.16418v1 公告类型：新 摘要：训练集的质量与多样性是决定机器学习原子间势（MLIP）可靠性的关键因素。然而，完整使用海量数据集通常并不切实际且存在冗余，因此，智能数据选择至关重要。一个主要瓶颈在于，当前缺乏用于统一访问、整理和子采样异构大规模化学数据集的基础设施，而这些数据集在结构、元数据和文件格式方面存在很大差异。为弥补这一空缺，我们提出了 ChemReporter，这是一个模块化且与具体方法无关的框架，可将任意分子与材料数据集转换为统一、可查询的表示形式，并将结果直接导出为适用于 MLIP 的训练数据。 ChemReporter 包含三个相互解耦的阶段：处理阶段，将原始数据集解析为分区式 Apache Parquet 数据仓库，并为其补充结构、物理和化学元数据；查询阶段，通过命令行界面（CLI）或 Python API，依据任意选择标准对该数据仓库进行筛选和采样，选择标准既可以是简单的物理约束，也可以是用户自定义的策略；导出阶段，将选定的子集以流式方式写入 HDF5 文件，从而可直接用于现代 MLIP 训练框架。在整个过程中，每个导出的数据点都可追溯至其原始数据条目；在配置和查询数据库版本相同的情况下，数据集导出结果也能够可靠复现。由于数据以可查询、基于磁盘存储的格式保存，ChemReporter 能够处理远超可用内存容量的数据集，从而在标准计算基础设施上扩展至包含十亿级结构的数据集。ChemReporter 已在 Apache License 2.0 许可下通过 GitHub 和 PyPI 发布。

    📐 方法要点：把异构分子与材料数据解析成分区式 Apache Parquet 仓库，并补充结构、物理和化学元数据。随后通过 CLI 或 Python API 按任意标准筛选、子采样并直接导出 MLIP 训练集。

    🔗 相关工作关联：这是面向材料数据工程的基础设施工作，补的是“数据可访问、可筛选、可追溯”的短板。与单纯发布大数据集不同，它强调方法无关的统一表示。

    💡 对你方向的启示：做 MLIP 前可以先把原始数据库标准化，再按覆盖度、冗余度和元素空间做子采样。这样能减少重复构型，提升训练集多样性，也方便后续复现实验。

    阅读原文 ↗
  6. 06
    Phonon-Mediated Thermal Transport in Nanocrystalline Silicon Using Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：arXiv:2607.06470v3 发布类型：替换 摘要：理解结构复杂材料中的声子介导热输运，仍然是下一代电子器件和纳米机械器件面临的核心挑战之一，因为晶界和界面无序会严重限制热耗散。尽管经典原子间势能够实现大规模模拟，但其有限的迁移能力可能导致振动性质和界面声子散射的计算不准确。在本研究中，我们结合高斯近似势、多原子簇展开模型、晶格动力学计算和分子动力学，建立了一个用于模拟块体硅和纳米晶硅热输运的机器学习框架。基于机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）得到的谐性和非谐性力常数，被纳入统一的 Phonopy/Phono3py 工作流程，用于计算声子色散、声子寿命和晶格热导率，从而对振动性质提供内部一致的描述。对于纳米晶硅，非平衡分子动力学模拟直接量化了晶界相关的热边界电阻，并揭示了其对界面粗糙度和所采用原子间描述的敏感性。与 Stillinger-Weber 势和 Tersoff 势相比，MLIPs 能够对块体和界面声子输运提供定量准确且内部一致的描述，从而有助于改进低维材料纳米尺度热输运的预测建模。

    📐 方法要点：将高斯近似势、多原子簇展开、晶格动力学和分子动力学串到同一流程里，先由 MLIP 提取谐性与非谐性力常数，再经 Phonopy/Phono3py 计算色散、寿命和晶格热导率。对纳米晶硅还用非平衡 MD 直接求晶界热边界电阻。

    🔗 相关工作关联：承接了声子输运的传统多尺度路线，但把势函数层、晶格动力学层和 MD 层统一到了一个 ML 驱动框架中。与经典势相比，它更适合界面粗糙和晶界散射敏感的体系。

    💡 对你方向的启示：若要研究纳米晶半导体热管理，可优先用 MLIP 生成力常数，再用谐性/非谐性与 NEMD 交叉校验。对晶界工程问题，应把热边界电阻而非只看体热导率作为核心指标。

    阅读原文 ↗
  7. 07
    氮杂三角烯结构中受挫反铁磁三自由基的拓扑工程

    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：arXiv:2608.16247v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：本文采用第一性原理电子结构计算，探讨了 Ag₂BiO₃ 非中心对称（Pnn2）相中所提出的键歧化绝缘态的起源。为阐明这一新型绝缘态，首先考察了最初提出的 Ag₂BiO₃ 中心对称金属（Pnna）相。我们的计算表明，该相中的价态跳跃 Bi⁴⁺ 离子更适合描述为 Bi³⁺L̲，其 Bi-(6s) 态完全填满并伴随一个配体空穴。然而，声子计算表明金属（Pnna）态在动力学上不稳定。通过氧八面体的呼吸畸变可实现结构稳定化，从而产生两个不等价的 Bi 位点，并使对称性降低为 Pnn2 相。电子结构计算进一步表明，Pnn2 相是一种键歧化绝缘体，其中 Bi 的名义电荷态可描述为：2[Bi³⁺L̲（Bi⁴⁺）] → Bi³⁺L̲²⁻δ（Bi1⁵⁺）+ Bi³⁺L̲δ（Bi2³⁺），突显了配体空穴在驱动绝缘态形成中的关键作用。随后，我们研究了在包含自旋-轨道耦合的绝缘（Pnn2）相中 Ag₂BiO₃ 的电子结构。我们的密度泛函理论（DFT）计算结合 k·p 模型哈密顿量分析表明，在非点式对称性约束下，正交布里渊区 X 和 Y 高对称点附近存在持久自旋织构，这使 Ag₂BiO₃ 成为自旋电子学应用的有前景候选材料。

    📐 方法要点：用第一性原理计算比较 Ag2BiO3 的中心对称 Pnna 金属相与非中心对称 Pnn2 相，并辅以声子计算判断动力学稳定性。结果显示 Pnna 态不稳定，氧八面体呼吸畸变后形成两个不等价 Bi 位点和键歧化绝缘体。

    🔗 相关工作关联：这是典型的配体空穴与键歧化问题，呼应了负电荷转移与氧化物绝缘化研究。与单纯价态计数相比，这里明确把 Bi3+L̲ 与结构畸变耦合起来解释。

    💡 对你方向的启示：研究含重元素氧化物时，不能只看名义价态，必须同时检查配体空穴和晶格动力学稳定性。若中心对称相不稳，可优先搜索呼吸模或八面体畸变诱导的绝缘相。

    Unlocking Multi-Component Bulk-Materials Molecular Dynamics with a Small-Footprint Machine Learning Interatomic Potential
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：arXiv:2608.16329v1 公告类型：新摘要：与纳米材料相对，块体材料需要在大空间尺度（约10⁹个原子或更多）上进行分子动力学（MD）模拟，才能充分捕捉其原子尺度物理性质。此前，引入机器学习原子间势（MLIP）已将MD扩展到这一尺度，但即便是单组分块体系统，也需要在高端超级计算机上使用数万块GPU。然而，多组分块体MD模拟仍几乎难以实现，因为现有MLIP的HBM占用——即使对单组分系统而言已经相当可观——在多组分场景下会爆炸式增长。本文提出了一种HBM占用很小的MLIP——不足现有MLIP的3%——从而仅用数百块GPU即可实现多组分块体MD。这一目标通过首先识别出特征向量和中间张量是现有MLIP中HBM占用的两个主要来源而实现。为解决这两类来源，我们通过引入物理和化学知识降低了特征向量的维度，并通过将所有内核激进地融合为单个超级内核，消除了中间张量。在评估中，所提出的MLIP使用144块NVIDIA A100 GPU对一个包含6种组分、原子数达1.14×10⁹的块体系统进行了MD模拟，而此前此类MD模拟的空间尺度仅限于单组分系统，且通常只能在配备数万块GPU的高端超级计算机上实现。

    📐 方法要点：通过压缩特征向量并将中间张量彻底内核融合，构造出 HBM 占用不足现有 MLIP 3% 的小足迹势函数。该设计面向多组分块体 MD，可把原本需要极大显存的任务压到数百块 GPU 上完成。

    🔗 相关工作关联：回应了多组分块体 MD 的显存瓶颈，这是从模型精度之外直接切入的系统工程问题。与常见的大模型势函数相比，它把可部署性放在首位。

    💡 对你方向的启示：如果目标是成分复杂的块体体系，可优先评估显存而不只是误差指标。模型设计时减少中间张量和特征维度，往往比单纯堆参数更有效。

    WF-Bench: A Benchmark for Neural Network WaveFunction Expressivity and Scaling Laws
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：arXiv:2605.29683v2 发布类型：替换 摘要：我们提出了一个用于神经网络波函数的全面基准数据集和经验尺度定律分析方法，通过将其与一系列著名的多体目标波函数进行匹配来实现。该数据集 WF-Bench 覆盖了强关联量子物质的多个不同物理区间，包括拓扑态、Wigner 晶体和超导波函数，为检验神经网络波函数的表达能力提供了一个多样而富有挑战性的测试平台。我们提出了一套系统且可复现的目标波函数匹配基准协议，使不同神经网络波函数架构之间能够进行一致的性能评估。通过以波函数保真度作为统一指标，我们发现了刻画可表示性如何依赖于系统尺寸和关键模型参数的经验尺度定律，其中包括行列式数目和模型深度。将该基准协议应用于 Psiformer 和 Ferminet 后，我们表明 WF-Bench 建立了一个由统一数据集驱动的框架，用于评估和比较神经网络波函数，并指导未来架构的设计。

    📐 方法要点：提出 WF-Bench 作为神经网络波函数基准，把多体目标波函数统一到一套匹配协议中，并以波函数保真度作为主指标。基准覆盖拓扑态、Wigner 晶体和超导波函数，并据此分析随系统尺寸、行列式数目和模型深度变化的经验尺度律。

    🔗 相关工作关联：这补上了神经网络波函数领域缺少统一 benchmark 的短板。与单个物理系统上的表现比较相比，它更强调跨架构、跨模型的一致评估。

    💡 对你方向的启示：以后比较神经网络波函数时，可先在 WF-Bench 上看表达能力和尺度律，再去做具体材料问题。对架构设计来说，行列式数目与深度应被视为可调的主要容量参数。

    Reinforcement LearningtoHarness Approximation Errors for Long-Time QuantumSimulation
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：arXiv:2608.20139v1 发布类型：cross 摘要：长时间尺度上的精确数字量子模拟受到近似模拟固有误差不断累积的限制。本文提出 RL-Trotter，这是一种强化学习框架，将不可避免的近似误差视为用于误差校正的资源，而不只是需要抑制的缺陷。我们表明，守恒律所提供的低维信息（如能量和能量方差）足以作为学习信号来引导智能体；在无法访问目标波函数的情况下，智能体能够学习自适应地调整一个标量，即下一步 Trotter 步长。通过优化整个长时间演化过程，而非单独优化各个步骤，RL-Trotter 能够发现具有自校正能力的序列，使后续误差补偿此前累积的误差，从而提高长时间动力学的精度。所学习的策略对测量噪声具有内在鲁棒性，能够大幅降低测量开销。此外，这些策略还能推广到此前未见过的、物理性质相似的初始态，并可从规模较小且能够进行经典模拟的系统迁移到大一个数量级的系统。这使得一种实用协议成为可能：先进行经典预训练，再直接部署到量子硬件上，或在量子硬件上进行有限微调。我们的研究为量子算法确立了更广阔的视角：近似演化中的误差可以被编排为实现高精度且资源高效的量子动力学的资源。

    📐 方法要点：RL-Trotter 把近似模拟误差当作可学习资源，利用能量和能量方差等低维守恒量作为强化学习信号，自适应调整下一步 Trotter 步长。策略在不访问目标波函数的情况下训练，并可从较小可经典模拟系统迁移到大一个数量级的系统。

    🔗 相关工作关联：这是把量子模拟误差控制从固定步长的数值分析，推进到闭环学习控制。与传统误差抑制相比，它利用误差累积本身形成自校正序列。

    💡 对你方向的启示：长时间量子动力学模拟可尝试用在线策略替代手工选步长。若实验或仿真只能读出守恒量，仍可用这些低维观测训练控制器。

01

本周总览#

先把握一周的主线，再进入交叉重点与专题全文速览。

整体概览

本周文献集中于交替磁性、低维磁性、量子铁电性及物理约束机器学习。Co1/4TaSe2、α-MnTe、MnTe和CoF2分别从能带、自旋劈裂、磁光响应与四极有序层面推进了交替磁性实验判据。少层WTe2、双铁电堆叠晶体管和钙钛矿极化密度波工作，将铁电极化与非线性输运、视觉计算及密度波结构联系起来。AI方向则由对称性硬约束、自动合成闭环、MLIP和4D-STEM自监督表征构成主线。

趋势观察

交替磁性从理论分类转向实验判据，ARPES、Kerr成像、共振散射和输运分别用于识别自旋劈裂、载流子依赖磁光响应及反铁四极序。铁电研究呈现从静态极化转向动态和计算功能的趋势，少层WTe2、量子铁电SrTiO3体系及双铁电晶体管覆盖了非线性霍尔、光操控和视觉计算。磁性器件方向强调非线性与拓扑纹理，包括斯格明子写入、磁子频率梳、超导二极管和自旋转矩振荡。AI方法则更加重视物理约束、对称性、有限温系综和不确定性，MLIP、PINN、主动学习及自动实验闭环成为高频技术路线。数据驱动模型的评价标准也从单一预测精度转向物理可行性、跨体系迁移和实验可验证性。

后续展望

交替磁材料下一步需要在单畴样品、载流子浓度、晶体缺陷和自旋轨道耦合之间建立可重复的定量对应，并区分本征响应与自掺杂、界面应变等外在因素。铁电AI器件仍需解决循环寿命、噪声、阵列一致性和端到端能耗，AI材料发现则应把对称性检查、形成能验证、合成反馈和不确定性估计纳入统一闭环。

中文摘要

arXiv:2602.13811v3 发布类型：替换交叉引用 摘要：物理信息神经网络（Physics-Informed Neural Networks, PINNs）是科学机器学习（SciML）中的一种新方法，它通过损失函数中的软约束，将偏微分方程形式的物理定律直接整合到神经网络中。本文研究了将 PINNs 应用于求解一维耦合电-弹动力系统的方法，该系统以应力-电荷形式描述线性压电性，由弹动力学方程和电动力学方程所支配。我们的仿真采用前馈网络架构，将时空坐标映射到机械位移和电势。我们的 PINN 模型在位移和电势上的全局相对 L2 误差分别达到 2.34% 和 4.87%。结果验证了 PINNs 作为耦合时变偏微分方程系统的有效无网格求解器的能力，但在耦合本征值系统中，误差累积和刚性问题仍然存在挑战。

English Abstract

arXiv:2602.13811v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks present a novel approach in SciML that integrates physical laws in the form of partial differential equations directly into the NN through soft constraints in the loss function. This work studies the application of PINNs to solve a one dimensional coupled electro-elastodynamic system modeling linear piezoelectricity in stress-charge form, governed by elastodynamic and electrodynamic equations. Our simulation employs a feedforward architecture, mapping space-time coordinates to mechanical displacement and electric potential. Our PINN model achieved global relative L2 errors of 2.34 and 4.87 percent for displacement and electric potential respectively. The results validate PINNs as effective mesh free solvers for coupled time-dependent PDE systems, though challenges remain regarding error accumulation and stiffness in coupled eigenvalue systems.

中文摘要

arXiv:2608.18714v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：机器学习模型正在材料发现领域取代第一性原理计算，而物理对称性是其中内置的核心保障。围绕应当在多大程度上将对称性硬编码而非让模型学习的争论，一直集中在旋转对称上，在那里，对称性误差就是近似误差。有些约束是精确的：对称性会强制某些物性张量严格为零，因此一个非零预测在物理上是不可能的，而不是仅仅不够准确。这里我们表明，模型能否做出这类预测在训练之前就由一个很少被报告的设计位决定，即其特征是否携带奇偶性标签，并推导出一个判据“奇偶性缺口”，它只需从群论出发就能计算出哪些性质和晶体会受到影响。我们在成对匹配的架构上进行评估，这些架构仅在这一位上不同；在两千个中心对称晶体上测试时，它们的压电张量必须为零，带奇偶性标签的分支结果落在浮点数下限，而仅含旋转对称的分支在 90% 至 96% 的晶体上预测出被禁止的响应，相差六个数量级，却没有精度代价。用显式零值进行训练并不能恢复精确性，而在冻结的通用势函数上接入一个输出头，会继承其骨干网络的对称群。随机初始化时做一次反射即可在数秒内验证该标签。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.18714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learned models are replacing first-principles calculations across materials discovery, and physical symmetry is the central guarantee built into them. The debate over how much symmetry to hard-wire rather than learn has run on rotations, where a symmetry error is an approximation error. Some constraints are exact: symmetry forces certain property tensors to exactly zero, so a nonzero prediction is physically impossible rather than inaccurate. Here we show that whether a model can make such predictions is decided before training by one rarely reported design bit, whether its features carry parity labels, and derive a criterion, the parity gap, that computes from group theory alone which properties and crystals are exposed. Across matched architecture pairs differing only in that bit, evaluated on two thousand centrosymmetric crystals whose piezoelectric tensor must vanish, parity-labelled arms sit at the floating-point floor while rotation-only arms predict forbidden responses on 90-96% of crystals, six orders of magnitude apart, at no accuracy cost. Training on explicit zeros does not recover exactness, and a head on a frozen universal potential inherits its backbone's symmetry group. One reflection at random initialization verifies the label in seconds.

页内定位所在专题
中文摘要

在本研究中，我们对一种用于物理储备池计算的涡旋自旋转矩振荡器（VSTO）进行了数值学习性能评估；该器件具有改进的自由层，称为改进型VSTO（m-VSTO），其自由层上叠加了一个半径更小的附加层（AL）。我们利用包含AL诱导势能形变的Thiele方程计算涡旋芯动力学。我们通过最大李雅普诺夫指数确定混沌边缘，并在时间复用储备池方案中量化短期记忆容量（STMC）和信息处理容量（IPC）。我们发现，m-VSTO在传统VSTO阈值电流以下的低电流、低磁场区域表现出有限的STMC和IPC，并且在功耗约为四分之一的情况下，IPC最高可达到约两倍。通过将瞬态时间的解析估计与李雅普诺夫指数数据相结合，还可以进一步解释IPC对脉冲宽度的依赖性。在广泛的亚阈值电流范围内，较长的脉冲宽度会促进更强的恢复诱导收缩，使系统趋向被沟槽俘获的轨道。相较之下，在接近阈值电流时，这种收缩速率的差异变得不那么明显，此时瞬态时间会迅速增加。因此，IPC在李雅普诺夫指数为负的稳定区域得到增强，而不是恰好在混沌边缘处增强。这些结果表明，对势能景观和依赖脉冲宽度的恢复动力学进行工程化设计，能够实现低功耗自旋电子物理储备池。

English Abstract

arXiv:2603.01351v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this study, we numerically evaluate the learning performance of a vortex spin-torque oscillator (VSTO) with a modified free layer, called a modified VSTO (m-VSTO), in which an additional layer (AL) of smaller radius is stacked on the free layer, for physical reservoir computing. The vortex-core dynamics are computed using the Thiele equation incorporating the potential deformation induced by the AL. We identify the edge of chaos from the maximal Lyapunov exponent and quantify the short-term memory capacity (STMC) as well as the information processing capacity (IPC) in a time-multiplexed reservoir scheme. We find that the m-VSTO exhibits finite STMC and IPC in a low-current and low-field regime below the threshold current of the conventional VSTO, and can achieve up to approximately twice the IPC with about one quarter of the power consumption. The pulse-width dependence of the IPC can be further interpreted by combining an analytical estimate of the transient time with Lyapunov-exponent data. Longer pulse widths promote stronger recovery-induced contraction toward the groove-trapped orbit over a wide range of subthreshold currents. In contrast, this difference in contraction rate becomes less pronounced near the threshold current, where the transient time increases rapidly. Consequently, the IPC is enhanced in a stable regime with a negative Lyapunov exponent rather than exactly at the edge of chaos. These results suggest that engineering the potential landscape and pulse-width-dependent recovery dynamics enables low-power spintronic physical reservoirs.

中文摘要

arXiv:2608.17200v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：稀土-过渡金属硼化物为永磁体设计提供关键结构基元；然而，这些成分相空间中的富锰区域仍基本未被探索。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种先进的机器学习辅助发现框架，用于探索 Y-Mn-B 三元体系。我们从数据库中已知结构生成的一百多万个假想结构出发，首先应用图神经网络预测材料稳定性以筛选有前景的候选物，随后使用机器学习原子间势弛豫其结构，最后用第一性原理计算验证结果。我们识别出 5 个稳定和近稳定的 Y-Mn-B 相，以及 61 个相对于三元凸包形成能在 100 meV/原子以内的亚稳化合物。其中，Y2Mn7B7 和 YMn4B4 在结构上类似于先前合成的 R₁₊ϵFe₄B₄ 一维非公度复合链化合物。与报道中强烈受抑制的 Fe 磁矩形成鲜明对比，我们的第一性原理计算显示，预测的 Mn 链相保留了可观的局域 Mn 磁矩（约 1.1 μ_B），并偏好铁磁有序。电子结构分析阐明了磁矩恢复的微观起源，即由类似 Stoner 不稳定性驱动的增强交换劈裂。我们还进行了系统的 Mn-Fe 替换，以确认从 Fe 到 Mn 的热力学连续性以及宏观磁化强度的单调增强。这些发现表明，在一维硼化物家族内进行有目标的过渡金属替换可以恢复过渡金属磁性，为设计新的磁性稀土-过渡金属硼化物提供了一条物理上可解释的路径。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.17200v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rare-earth transition-metal borides offer critical structural motifs for permanent-magnet design; however, the manganese-rich regions within these compositional phase spaces remain largely unexplored. In this work, we develop an advanced machine-learning-assisted discovery framework to explore Y-Mn-B ternary system. Starting from over one million hypothetical structures generated from known structures in databases, we filtered promising candidates by first applying graph neural networks to predict material stability, then using machine-learning-interatomic-potential to relax their structures, and finally validating the results with first-principles calculations. We identify 5 stable and near-stable Y-Mn-B phases along with 61 metastable compounds with the formation energy within 100 meV/atom with respect to the ternary convex hull. Among them, Y2Mn7B7 and YMn4B4 are structurally analogous to the previously synthesized R₁₊ϵFe₄B₄ 1D incommensurate composite chain compounds. In striking contrast to the strongly suppressed Fe moments reported, our first-principles calculations reveal that the predicted Mn-chain phases preserve sizable local Mn moments (approximately 1.1 μ_B) and favored ferromagnetic ordering. Electronic structure analyses elucidate the microscopic origin of moment recovery via an enhanced exchange splitting driven by a Stoner-like instability. We also perform systematic Mn-Fe substitution to confirm the thermodynamic continuity and a monotonic enhancement of the macroscopic magnetization, from Fe to Mn. These findings indicate that targeted transition-metal substitution within a one-dimensional boride family can recover transition-metal magnetism, offering a physically interpretable route for designing new magnetic rare-earth transition-metal borides.

理解强关联量子磁体的集体相依赖于理论上可处理且具有精确微观控制的模型体系。反铁磁自旋梯提供了这样的环境，在半填充时承载磁场可调的有能隙和无能隙相，并在掺杂后表现出非常规配对倾向。在这里，我们在半填充锗量子点阵列中实现了一个可编程海森堡自旋梯，其交换相互作用可按位点分辨并连续调节。在固定磁场下，我们改变横档和梯腿耦合，以绘制横档单重态、倾斜反铁磁态和完全极化相。结合平衡和动力学测量的哈密顿量学习协议对该自旋梯进行了定量表征，并纳入自旋-轨道相互作用以再现实验观测到的交叉行为。对高阶自旋关联的测量，包括传统体相探针无法获得的四点关联，尽管体系尺寸有限，仍揭示了底层相结构的特征。我们的结果确立了锗量子点阵列作为量子磁性的可控平台，并为研究掺杂自旋梯中的非常规超导性开辟了路径。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.17789v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding collective phases of strongly correlated quantum magnets relies on theoretically tractable model systems with precise microscopic control. Antiferromagnetic spin ladders provide such a setting, hosting field-tunable gapped and gapless phases at half filling and unconventional pairing tendencies upon doping. Here, we realize a programmable Heisenberg spin ladder in a half-filled germanium quantum dot array featuring site-resolved, continuously tunable exchange interactions. Under a fixed magnetic field, we vary the rung and leg coupling to map the rung-singlet, canted antiferromagnetic, and fully polarized phases. Hamiltonian-learning protocols combining equilibrium and dynamical measurements quantitatively characterize the ladder, incorporating spin-orbit interactions to reproduce the observed crossover behavior. Measurements of higher-order spin correlators -- including four-point correlations inaccessible to conventional bulk probes -- reveal signatures of the underlying phase structure despite the finite size. Our results establish germanium quantum dot arrays as a controllable platform for quantum magnetism, opening routes to investigate unconventional superconductivity in doped ladders.

中文摘要

将机器学习（ML）融入材料科学，为实现全自主合成流程提供了一条变革性途径。对于分子束外延（MBE）这类精密薄膜沉积技术而言，这种自动化对于克服高维热力学相空间中耗时的人工探索至关重要。现有的机器学习辅助薄膜生长方法主要依赖连续贝叶斯优化（BO）模型，并假设参数景观是平滑的。因此，这些方法难以捕捉二元量子材料中固有的突变式晶体学相边界和狭窄生长窗口。在此，我们展示了一种基于序贯模型优化（SMBO）的主动学习协议，专门用于此类化合物的闭环分子束外延。为了克服连续模型的局限性，同时保留传统贝叶斯优化中高效的探索—利用逻辑，我们将能够捕捉高度非线性相变的随机森林替代模型、反映生长过程热力学约束的模型，与用于预测最佳生长参数的期望改进函数相结合。我们将这一组合式SMBO框架应用于拓扑外尔铁磁体Fe₃Sn的分子束外延。Fe₃Sn以亚稳态线化合物的形式存在。借助少于20次生长迭代的小型初始训练集，我们的主动学习循环能够迅速穿越复杂的优化景观，识别出由尖锐相变限定的最佳生长窗口。仅经过4次主动学习迭代，绝对预测误差就降低了一半，达到约10%。这一数据高效的框架为功能量子材料的自主发现和薄膜合成铺平了道路。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.17742v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The integration of machine learning (ML) into materials science offers a transformative pathway toward fully autonomous synthesis workflows. For precise thin-film deposition techniques like molecular beam epitaxy (MBE), this automation is critical to overcome the time-consuming, manual navigation of high-dimensional thermodynamic phase spaces. Existing approaches for ML-assisted thin film growth predominantly rely on continuous Bayesian optimization (BO) models that assume smooth parameter landscapes. Consequently, they struggle to capture the abrupt crystallographic phase boundaries and narrow growth windows inherent to binary quantum materials. Here, we demonstrate an active learning protocol based on Sequential Model-Based Optimization (SMBO) designed specifically for the closed-loop MBE of such compounds. To overcome the limitations of continuous models while retaining the efficient exploration-exploitation logic of traditional BO, we combine a random forest surrogate model capable of capturing highly non-linear phase transitions and thermodynamics constraints of the growth process with an expected improvement function to predict optimum growth parameters. We apply this combined SMBO framework to the MBE of the topological Weyl ferromagnet Fe₃Sn, which exists as a metastable line compound. Using a small initial training set of fewer than twenty growth iterations, our active learning loop rapidly navigates a complex optimization landscape to identify an optimum growth window bounded by sharp transitions. Within only four active learning iterations, the absolute predictive error is halved to approx10%. This data-efficient framework paves the way for the autonomous discovery and thin-film synthesis of functional quantum materials.

arXiv:2608.15900v1 公告类型：new 摘要：数据驱动的材料发现在插值时比在外推时更可靠，而且很少达到新的结构类型。我们提出了 MatEvolve，这是一个用于晶体设计的 agentic-AI 框架，它会为每个候选结构给出明确的理由并进行测试。该智能体以可解释的基元语言进行推理，将每个晶体写成一个基元剖面，描述构成它的重复几何模式——即基元。基元剖面不仅仅是材料的描述，也是材料设计的媒介：智能体编辑该剖面，并由修改后的剖面构建晶体，最有前景的候选结构则通过第一性原理计算加以验证。将 MatEvolve 应用于稀土低用量永磁体设计时，MatEvolve——基于无需微调的最先进语言模型 Claude Fable 5 构建——在相同验证预算下，达到新结构原型的频率比生成模型高出三倍以上，同时靶向磁体命中率相当。除设计之外，对所发现晶体的人类可读剖面进行分析还揭示了结构-性质关系。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.15900v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Data-driven materials discovery interpolates more reliably than it extrapolates and seldom reaches new structure types. We present MatEvolve, an agentic-AI framework designing crystals, proposing each candidate with a stated rationale and testing it. The agent reasons in an interpretable emphlanguage of motifs, writing each crystal as a emphmotif profile that describes the recurring geometric patterns---the emphmotifs---composing it. The motif profile serves not merely as a description of a material but as the medium for material design: the agent edits the profile and constructs a crystal from the modified one, and the most promising candidates are validated by first-principles calculation. Applied to the design of rare-earth-lean permanent magnets, MatEvolve---built on the state-of-the-art language model Claude Fable~5 without fine-tuning---reaches new structural prototypes more than three times as often as generative models under an equal validation budget, at a comparable on-target-magnet rate. Beyond design, analysing the discovered crystals' human-readable profiles reveals structure--property relationships.

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.16644v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: MXenes, two-dimensional transition-metal carbides and nitrides, are typically obtained from MAX phases, yet historical reports suggest a broader, largely unexplored chemical space. Here we combine machine-learning-assisted database mining with experiments to uncover overlooked multilayer (ml) MXenes. Screening of repositories reveals a "Treasure Chest" of 38 previously synthesized but unrecognized ml-MXene candidates. Guided by these findings, we rediscover five MXenes using a rapid, scalable self-propagating high-temperature synthesis that requires no sustained external heating and completes within minutes. Inspired by the identified chemistries, we further realize 11 previously unexplored rare-earth-based M2CT2 MXenes (M= Pr, Nd, Sm, Gd, Tb, Ho, and Tm). Experiments and theory reveal semiconducting behavior and diverse magnetic states across this family. Together, these results expand the MXene family and demonstrate a data-driven strategy for accelerating materials discovery through sustainable methods.

arXiv:2608.15806v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们研究了在纵向和复横向磁场作用下的非厄米横场伊辛链的基态性质与量子临界行为。为处理这一相互作用多体问题，我们采用基于受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）的实值神经量子态，并使用变分蒙特卡洛（VMC）采样进行优化。有限链的谱分析揭示了与自发宇称-时间（PT）对称性破缺相关的例外点。我们构建了一个实值 RBM 框架，用于重构非厄米哈密顿量的基态本征态。与精确对角化的基准比较表明，RBM 方法能够准确再现基态能量、磁化强度和自旋-自旋关联。将分析扩展到更大的系统尺寸后，我们识别出一种由 PT 对称性破缺及磁有序出现所表征的非厄米量子相变。我们的结果表明，实值神经量子态是研究相互作用非厄米量子系统临界现象的一种高效且可扩展的框架。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.15806v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the ground-state properties and quantum critical behavior of a non-Hermitian transverse-field Ising chain subjected to longitudinal and complex transverse magnetic fields. To address this interacting many-body problem, we employ real-valued neural quantum states based on Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs), optimized using Variational Monte Carlo (VMC) sampling. Spectral analysis of finite chains reveals exceptional points associated with spontaneous parity-time (PT) symmetry breaking. A real-valued RBM framework is developed to reconstruct the ground-state eigenstates of the non-Hermitian Hamiltonian. Benchmark comparisons with exact diagonalization demonstrate that the RBM approach accurately reproduces the ground-state energy, magnetization, and spin-spin correlations. Extending the analysis to larger system sizes, we identify a non-Hermitian quantum phase transition characterized by PT-symmetry breaking and the emergence of magnetic order. Our results establish real-valued neural quantum states as an efficient and scalable framework for investigating critical phenomena in interacting non-Hermitian quantum systems.

arXiv:2608.16592v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：等变原子模型通常使用 Clebsch-Gordan 张量积（CGTP）或边对齐的 SO(2) 运算。CGTP 支持一般的 O(3) 表示，但在角动量阶数较高时计算开销很大，而现有的局部 SO(2) 坐标系方法是为 SO(3) 或 O(3) 的自然宇称子集而设计的。因此，当极向张量和赝张量同时出现时，它们并不能提供完整的局部表示。在本工作中，我们针对非共线磁性、电场和磁场提出了一种广义的 Wigner-6j 卷积，提供了一种可在 O(3) 下处理任意节点等变特征的通用卷积方案。我们进一步基于局部 O(2) 坐标系发展了一套完整的 O(3) 卷积框架，将 CGTP 的计算复杂度从 O(L6) 降低到 O(L3)。我们建立了全局 O(3) 不可约表示（irrep）与局部 O(2) 不可约表示之间的对应关系，并利用这一对应关系构造了一个闭合的算子系统，由 O2Linear、O2TensorProduct 和 O2Gate 组成。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.16592v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Equivariant atomistic models commonly use either Clebsch Gordan tensor product(CGTP) or edge aligned SO(2) operationsCGTP support general O(3) representations but become expensive at high angular degree, while existing local SO(2) frame methods are designed for SO(3) or the natural-parity subset of O(3). They therefore do not provide a complete local representation when polar tensors and pseudotensors occur at the same time. In this work, we introduce a generalized Wigner-6j convolution for non-collinear magnetism, electric fields, and magnetic fields, providing a general convolution scheme under O(3) that can incorporate arbitrary node-wise equivariant features. We further develop a complete O(3) convolution framework based on local O(2) frames, reducing the computational complexity of CGTPs from O(L6) to O(L3). We establish the correspondence between global O(3) irreducible representations (irreps) and local O(2) irreps and use this correspondence to construct a closed operator system comprising O2Linear, O2TensorProduct, and O2Gate.

摘要：物理储备池计算是实现快速、节能的计算机视觉、自然语言处理和一般模式识别的一种有前景的方法。本文提出了一种基于磁振子-光电振荡器（MOEO）的物理储备池。该方法使我们能够将短期记忆和非线性作为彼此独立的系统组件来实现。该器件的光路采用光纤延迟线作为短期记忆元件。微波路径负责将输入数据进行非线性映射，从而映射到更高维空间。传播于钇铁石榴石（YIG）铁氧体薄膜中的自旋波具有很强的四波非线性，使这一过程得以实现。通过完成与具体任务无关的短期记忆（STM）任务和奇偶校验（PC）任务，对储备池的性能进行了评估。此外，还建立了该基于MOEO的储备池的数值模型。储备池性能的数值模拟结果与实验数据吻合良好。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.16388v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physical reservoir computing is a promising approach for fast and energy efficient computer vision, natural language processing, and general pattern recognition. This work presents a physical reservoir based on magnonic-optoelectronic oscillator (MOEO). This approach allowed us to realize short-term memory and nonlinearity as separate system components. The device`s optical path uses a fiber-optic delay line as a short-term-memory element. The microwave path is responsible for nonlinear mapping of input data to a higher-dimensional space. The strong four-wave nonlinearity of spin waves propagating in an yttrium-iron garnet (YIG) ferrite film enables the process. The reservoir performance is evaluated by completing task-independent tests known as short-term memory (STM) and parity-check (PC) tasks. In addition, a numerical model of the MOEO based reservoir is developed. Results of the numerical simulation of the reservoir performance are in good agreement with the experimental data.

中文摘要

理解晶格动力学如何介导极化子跃迁，对于设计多功能关联氧化物至关重要。这里，我们展示了室温下的色散声子激发，并阐明了Ni1+-Ni2+极化子跃迁机制，以及在金红石铌酸盐这一罕见的室温磁介电体系中，即便处于磁性短程有序态也存在罕见的自旋-电荷-声子耦合。我们通过非弹性中子散射（INS）揭示了室温色散声子激发，并结合基于机器学习的声子计算，建立了极化子跃迁机制的微观起源。关于由色散声子驱动的极化子跃迁的实验依据十分稀少。INS测量显示在21、33和47 meV处存在显著的色散声子激发，表明存在集体晶格动力学，它们通过耦合的电荷-自旋-声子相互作用促进了离域极化子的传播。色散声子与载流子耦合，并促进相关的NiO6晶格畸变，从而使离域极化子跃迁得以发生。4和8 meV处的低能磁激发表明，在变形的NiO6八面体中存在局域短程磁关联或由自旋轨道耦合诱导的各向异性，这一点已得到充分讨论。机器学习声子计算再现了实验观察到的声子激发，并显示出晶格不稳定性，这与极化子生成导致的动态局域畸变相一致。这些发现为金红石氧化物体系中介导极化子跃迁的电荷-自旋-声子耦合机制提供了微观证据。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.14234v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding how lattice dynamics mediate polaron hopping is essential for designing multifunctional correlated oxides. Here, we demonstrate room-temperature dispersive phonon excitations and elucidate the Ni1+-Ni2+ polaron-hopping mechanism and the presence of rare spin-charge-phonon coupling even in a magnetically short-range-ordered state in rutile niobate, a rare room-temperature magnetodielectric system. We reveal room-temperature dispersive phonon excitations using inelastic neutron scattering (INS), complemented by machine-learning-based phonon calculations, to establish the microscopic origin of the polaron-hopping mechanism. Experimental evidence of dispersive phonon-driven polaron hopping is scarce. INS measurements show significant dispersive phonon excitations at 21, 33, and 47 meV, implying collective lattice dynamics that enable delocalized polaron propagation via coupled charge-spin-phonon interactions. Dispersive phonons couple to charge carriers and promote correlated NiO6 lattice distortions, facilitating delocalized polaron hopping. Low-energy magnetic excitations at 4 and 8 meV indicate the presence of local short-range magnetic correlations or spin-orbit-coupling-induced anisotropy in deformed NiO6 octahedra, which are thoroughly discussed. Machine-learning phonon calculations replicate the experimentally observed phonon excitations and demonstrate lattice instability, which is compatible with dynamic local distortions caused by polaron production. These findings provide microscopic evidence for a coupled charge-spin-phonon mechanism that mediates polaron hopping in rutile oxide systems.

中文摘要

有效哈密顿量将微观相互作用与量子材料中可测量的集体行为联系起来，但直接从实验确定其参数仍然是一个具有挑战性的反问题。我们提出一种监督式机器学习框架，可从非线性太赫兹二维相干光谱中推断哈密顿量参数。一个经过校准的正向模型从候选哈密顿量生成光谱，一个通用的预处理流程将模拟光谱和实验光谱映射到同一表示中，神经网络则学习从光谱指纹到微观参数的逆映射。我们以稀土正铁氧体为例展示该方法，使用包含交换作用、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用、各向异性和阻尼的两子晶格 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 自旋模型。合成基准测试表明，非线性光谱编码了线性响应所固定参数之外的参数信息；推断精度随物理光谱灵敏度变化，而通过使用多个脉冲间延迟可提高对噪声的鲁棒性。将该方法应用于 Sm0.4Er0.6FeO3 的实验 THz-2DCS 数据时，推断出的参数产生了物理上合理的正向模拟，而仍然存在的差异则指出了约化模型的局限。这些结果确立了 THz-2DCS 作为有效哈密顿量推断与模型改进的数据丰富平台的地位，使得能够由实验驱动识别微观相互作用，并为理解、预测并最终控制量子材料的涌现性质奠定基础。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.14460v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Effective Hamiltonians connect microscopic interactions to measurable collective behavior in quantum materials, but determining their parameters directly from experiment remains a challenging inverse problem. We introduce a supervised machine-learning framework that infers Hamiltonian parameters from nonlinear terahertz two-dimensional coherent spectra. A calibrated forward model generates spectra from candidate Hamiltonians, a common preprocessing pipeline maps simulated and experimental spectra into the same representation, and a neural network learns the inverse map from spectral fingerprints to microscopic parameters. We demonstrate the approach for rare-earth orthoferrites using a two-sublattice Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert spin model with exchange, Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction, anisotropies, and damping. Synthetic benchmarks show that nonlinear spectra encode parameters beyond those fixed by the linear response, with inference accuracy tracking the physical spectral sensitivity and robustness against noise improved by using multiple inter-pulse delays. Applied to experimental THz-2DCS data from Sm₀.₄Er₀.₆FeO₃, the inferred parameters yield physically reasonable forward simulations, while remaining discrepancies identify limitations of the reduced model. These results establish THz-2DCS as a data-rich platform for effective-Hamiltonian inference and model refinement, enabling experimentally driven identification of microscopic interactions while providing a foundation for understanding, predicting, and ultimately controlling the emergent properties of quantum materials.

中文摘要

arXiv:2608.19352v1 公告类型：新

摘要：淬火无序能够深刻改变相变行为。在低维系统中，理论预测，即使是微弱的淬火无序，也能使与一级相变相关的热力学不连续性变得平滑。在本研究中，我们采用时域太赫兹光谱学，研究了准二维三聚化 kagome 范德华磁体家族 Nb₃Cl₈₋ₓBrₓ（x=0、1 和 8）。我们观察到，随着 Br 的取代，出现了一个额外的声子分支；随着 Br 浓度增加，该分支的谱权重增大、频率软化。声子频率随温度的演化表明，Nb₃Cl₈ 中存在一个具有宏观相共存和热滞后的清晰一级相变。相比之下，具有取代无序的化合物 Nb₃Cl₇Br 虽然仍保留热滞后，但其相变显著展宽，且无法分辨出宏观相共存。这些观测揭示了无序诱导的相变碎片化：相变被分解为局部有利的畴，而不是由稳定相界分隔的定义明确的体相。该行为与 Imry-Wortis 和 Aizenman-Wehr 关于淬火无序在低维系统中作用的理论情景一致：淬火无序会使宏观相共存失稳，并使与一级相变相关的热力学不连续性变得平滑。尽管无法分辨出相共存，无序化合物中仍然存在热滞后，这表明通常被视为一级相变特征的同一标志的这两个现象实际上具有不同的起源，并且可以被无序彼此分离。此外，我们的结果表明，Nb₃Cl₈₋ₓBrₓ 是研究低维系统中无序对一级相变影响的一个很有前景的平台。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.19352v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quenched disorder can profoundly modify phase transitions. In low-dimensional systems, theory predicts that even weak quenched disorder can round the thermodynamic discontinuities associated with a first-order phase transition. Here, we employ time-domain terahertz spectroscopy to investigate the quasi-two-dimensional trimerized kagome van der Waals magnet family Nb₃Cl₈₋ₓBrₓ (x=0, 1 and 8). We observe the emergence of an additional phonon branch upon Br substitution, whose spectral weight increases and frequency softens with increasing Br concentration. The temperature evolution of the phonon frequencies reveals a clean first-order transition in Nb₃Cl₈ characterized by macroscopic phase coexistence and thermal hysteresis. In contrast, the transition in the substitutionally disordered compound Nb₃Cl₇Br retains its hysteresis while exhibiting a substantially broadened transition with no resolvable macroscopic phase coexistence. These observations reveal disorder-induced fragmentation of the transition into locally favored domains instead of well-defined bulk phases separated by stable phase boundaries. The behavior is consistent with the Imry-Wortis and the Aizenman-Wehr scenarios for the effect of quenched disorder in low-dimensional systems, which destabilizes macroscopic phase coexistence and rounds the thermodynamic discontinuities associated with first-order transitions. Thermal hysteresis persists in the disordered compound despite the lack of resolvable coexistence, indicating that the two features often treated as a single hallmark of first-order character arise distinctly and can be separated by disorder. Moreover, our results establish Nb₃Cl₈₋ₓBrₓ as a promising platform for investigating the effects of disorder on first-order transitions in low-dimensional systems.

摘要：稀土范德瓦耳斯磁体为在块体晶体中结合强自旋轨道耦合、大磁矩和低维性提供了一条途径。我们对卤氧化镝 DyOX（X = Cl、Br、I）开展了比较研究。这些化合物实现了由 Dy³⁺磁矩构成的方形双��网络，层间由可调范德瓦耳斯间隙分隔。结构精修表明，随着卤化物离子半径增大，双层间距显著扩张，而局部双层几何结构几乎保持不变。磁化强度和热容测量显示，三种化合物均存在两个低温反常：发生于 TN ~ 7–10 K 的反铁磁有序，以及位于 TQ ~ 27–30 K 附近的较宽反常。对 DyOCl 和 DyOBr 进行的单晶磁化测量确立了强烈的 c 轴难轴各向异性，这与 DyOCl 的晶场分析结果一致；后者显示出类似 XY 型的基态 g 张量。中子衍射表明，DyOCl 中存在长程反铁磁有序；而 DyOBr 和 DyOI 则表现出尖锐的磁散射，同时伴随类似 Warren 型的弥散特征，这与强劲的面内关联以及不完美的双层间配准相一致。对 DyOCl 进行的非弹性中子散射在约 25–30 meV 处识别出晶场激发，并在约 10 meV 处发现了一个额外的磁模；该磁模的温度依赖性与高温反常相关。综合来看，这些结果确立了 DyOX 是一个可调控的准二维稀土磁体家族，并指出了与低能晶场态相关的候选多极物理。要确定 TQ 处的序参量，还需要采用共振 X 射线散射或弹性常数测量等对四极有序的直接探测手段。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.19421v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rare-earth van der Waals magnets provide a route to combining strong spin-orbit coupling, large magnetic moments, and reduced dimensionality in bulk crystals. We report a comparative study of the dysprosium oxyhalides DyOX (X = Cl, Br, I), which realize square-bilayer networks of Dy3+ moments separated by a tunable van der Waals gap. Structural refinements show that increasing the halide ionic radius strongly expands the inter-bilayer spacing while leaving the local bilayer geometry nearly unchanged. Magnetization and heat-capacity measurements reveal two low-temperature anomalies in all three compounds: antiferromagnetic order at TN ~ 7-10 K and a broader anomaly near TQ ~ 27-30 K. Single-crystal magnetization on DyOCl and DyOBr establishes a strong hard-c-axis anisotropy, consistent with crystal-field analysis of DyOCl, which yields an XY-like ground-state g tensor. Neutron diffraction shows long-range antiferromagnetic order in DyOCl, whereas DyOBr and DyOI exhibit sharp magnetic scattering coexisting with Warren-like diffuse features, consistent with robust in-plane correlations and imperfect inter-bilayer registry. Inelastic neutron scattering on DyOCl identifies crystal-field excitations near 25-30 meV and an additional magnetic mode near 10 meV whose temperature dependence is tied to the high-temperature anomaly. Taken together, these results establish DyOX as a tunable family of quasi-two-dimensional rare-earth magnets and point to candidate multipolar physics associated with low-lying crystal-field states. Direct probes of quadrupolar order, such as resonant x-ray scattering or elastic-constant measurements, will be required to determine the order parameter at TQ.

arXiv:2608.19465v1 发布类型：新论文 摘要：我们报道了对 DyCuAs₂ 低温晶体结构和磁结构的高分辨率同步辐射 X 射线衍射及 X 射线共振磁散射（XRMS）研究。DyCuAs₂ 是 RECuAs₂ 家族的一员，该家族在反铁磁转变温度以上表现出电阻率极小值。同步辐射衍射测量表明，在实验分辨率范围内，DyCuAs₂ 在低温下仍保持四方对称性，尽管在反铁磁转变温度 T_N≈7 K 附近，晶格参数 a 和 c 均出现显著异常，表明存在强磁弹性耦合。Dy L₃ 边的 XRMS 测量证实，在 T_N 以下出现公度反铁磁有序，其 AFM 布拉格峰位于 q = (0, 0, 0.5)。表示分析以及 AFM 布拉格峰强度计算将该磁结构确定为 Γ₁₀ 表示，其由面内 Dy 磁矩沿 c 轴按 ++-- 序列堆垛构成。因此，该磁结构与此前报道的 SmCuAs₂ 磁结构相同。DyCuAs₂、SmCuAs₂ 和 GdCuAs₂ 之间的比较表明，面内 AFM 有序及其在四方晶格上相关的磁阻挫与 RECuAs₂ 家族中电阻率极小值的出现密切相关。同时，DyCuAs₂ 中观测到的增强晶格响应和更强磁场敏感性表明，磁弹性相互作用和自旋-轨道相互作用在决定这种异常输运行为的稳健性方面也发挥着重要作用。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.19465v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report high-resolution synchrotron X-ray diffraction and X-ray resonant magnetic scattering (XRMS) studies of the low-temperature crystal and magnetic structures of DyCuAs₂, a member of the RE{}CuAs₂ family exhibiting a resistivity minimum above the antiferromagnetic transition temperature. Synchrotron diffraction measurements reveal that DyCuAs₂ preserves tetragonal symmetry down to low temperature within the experimental resolution, although pronounced anomalies in both lattice parameters a and c are observed near the antiferromagnetic transition temperature, Tₘₐₜₕᵣₘ Napprox7~K, indicating strong magnetoelastic coupling. XRMS measurements at the Dy L₃ edge establish commensurate antiferromagnetic ordering below Tₘₐₜₕᵣₘ N with AFM Bragg peaks at qq{} = (0, 0, 0.5). Representation analysis and calculations of the AFM Bragg peak intensities identify the magnetic structure as the Γ₁₀ representation, consisting of in-plane Dy moments stacked along the ç{} axis in a ++-- sequence. The magnetic structure is therefore identical to that previously reported for SmCuAs₂. Comparison among DyCuAs₂, SmCuAs₂, and GdCuAs₂ suggests that in-plane AFM order and the associated magnetic frustration on the tetragonal lattice are closely connected to the emergence of the resistivity minimum in the RE{}CuAs₂ family. At the same time, the enhanced lattice response and stronger magnetic-field sensitivity observed in DyCuAs₂ imply that magnetoelastic and spin-orbit interactions additionally play important roles in determining the robustness of this anomalous transport behavior.

中文摘要

arXiv:2608.19476v1　发布类型：新论文　摘要：我们提出了一种基于交替磁性多铁材料的自旋电子忆电容效应。我们确定稀土钒酸盐 RVO₃ 是一个具体的平台，其所有关键参数均与实测性质相对应。在振荡电场作用下，由此产生的电荷电流和自旋电流描绘出尖点滞回环，并在零场处以切线方式闭合——这是忆电容器型、二类忆器件行为的典型特征——其中电荷电流密度约为经过优化的自旋转移力矩磁隧道结所报道的最低确定性开关电流密度的 3.6 倍。我们在理论上将该系统建模为一种通过 Su--Schrieffer--Heeger 型键调制形成的二聚化双轨道 d 波交替磁晶格，其思想源自自旋依赖的 Rice--Mele 模型，从而将交替磁有序与可由电场切换的电荷极化和自旋极化耦合起来。相应的极化环在零场处以切线方式闭合，并产生变号且依赖历史的“蝴蝶形”微��电容，由此表明该器件是真正的忆电容器。两种响应均受到同一反演对称性的保护，因此电荷通道和自旋通道能够同时切换，无需单独控制。这些结果表明，以 RVO₃ 为具体实现的交替磁性多铁材料，是一种用于电荷与自旋电子存储相结合的高效非易失性平台。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.19476v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a spintronic memcapacitance effect based upon altermagnetic multiferroic materials. We identify the rare-earth vanadates RVO₃ as a concrete platform, with all key parameters tied to measured properties. Under an oscillating electric field, the resulting charge and spin currents trace pinched hysteresis loops that close tangentially at zero field -- the hallmark of memcapacitive, type-2 memdevice behavior -- with charge current densities exceeding, by a factor of about 3.6, the lowest deterministic switching current density reported for optimized spin-transfer-torque magnetic tunnel junctions. We model the system theoretically as a dimerized two-orbital d-wave altermagnetic lattice via a Su--Schrieffer--Heeger-type bond modulation, in the spirit of the spin-dependent Rice--Mele model, thereby coupling the altermagnetic order to field-switchable charge and spin polarizations. The associated polarization loops close tangentially at zero field and yield a sign-changing, history-dependent ``butterfly'' differential capacitance, identifying the device as a genuine memcapacitor. Both responses are protected by the same inversion symmetry, so charge and spin channels switch simultaneously with no separate control needed. These results establish altermagnetic multiferroics, realized concretely in RVO₃, as an efficient, non-volatile platform for combined electric and spintronic memory.

中文摘要

铁电材料的功能取决于极化、应变、晶格旋转和结构有序性在空间中的组织方式及其耦合，而这些信息可以通过原子分辨扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）图像获取。传统上，对定量原子分辨 STEM 数据的解释依赖于定位原子柱，并将拟合得到的坐标转换为局域结构描述符。在本文中，我们发展了一种基于场的方法：将原子分辨图像表示为空间变化的潜在布拉格场，其振幅和相位能够提供晶体有序性、晶格位移、应变、旋转以及特定模式残余结构的连续分布图。观测到的原子分辨图像则由这些潜在场解码得到。我们将该框架应用于一系列 Sm 含量为 0–20% 的 Sm 替代 BiFeO3 图像，这些图像跨越了由成分驱动的 R3c 铁电相与正交、非极性 Pnma 相之间的边界。我们采用传统的原子分辨参数化方法进行独立验证，结果表明，重构得到的布拉格振幅能够跟踪局部原子柱强度，而由场导出的剪切能够重现原子拟合所获得的晶胞角度畸变。综合分析揭示出一种系统演化过程：在低 Sm 浓度下存在扩展的铁电畴；在中等成分下出现并扩大具有周期加倍 Pnma 有序的局域区域；在高 Sm 含量下则形成彼此连通、由 Pnma 相主导的状态。周期加倍有序伴随着增强的剪切和晶格旋转，以及铁电畴结构的逐步重组。这些结果表明，潜在场重构是原子定位方法的一种具有物理可解释性的补充，并为解析铁电材料中由成分驱动的相演化提供了统一框架。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.19544v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Functionalities of ferroelectric materials are governed by the spatial organization and coupling of polarization, strain, lattice rotation, and structural order accessible via atomically resolved scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) images. Quantitative interpretation of atomic-resolution STEM data has conventionally relied on locating atomic columns and converting their fitted coordinates into local structural descriptors. Here, we develop a field-based approach in which atomic-resolution images are represented by spatially varying latent Bragg fields, whose amplitudes and phases provide continuous maps of crystalline order, lattice displacement, strain, rotation, and mode-specific residual structure. The observed atomically resolved images are decoded from the latent fields. We apply this framework to image series of Sm-substituted BiFeO3 spanning 0-20% Sm and crossing the composition-driven boundary between the R3c ferroelectric phase and the orthorhombic, nonpolar Pnma phase. Conventional atom-resolved parameterization is used as an independent validation, showing that reconstructed Bragg amplitude tracks local atomic-column intensity and that field-derived shear reproduces unit-cell angular distortions obtained from atom fitting. The combined analysis reveals a systematic evolution from extended ferroelectric domains at low Sm concentration, through the appearance and growth of localized regions with period-doubled Pnma order at intermediate compositions, to a connected Pnma-dominated state at high Sm content. The period-doubled order is accompanied by enhanced shear and lattice rotation and by progressive reorganization of the ferroelectric domain structure. These results establish latent-field reconstruction as a physically interpretable complement to atom finding and provide a unified framework for resolving composition-driven phase evolution in ferroic materials.

中文摘要

我们报道了铁磁纳米环中扭曲磁振子频率梳（tMFC）及其高阶模式的出现，这源于涡旋核回旋运动与方位角自旋波模式之间的强非线性耦合。频率梳线携带不同的轨道角动量，其量子数以单位为间隔排列，而其形成遵循由能量和角动量同时守恒所决定的选择定则。我们证明，孔径是一个强有力的调控参数：减小孔径能够保持传统的 tMFC，而增大孔径则会引入额外的磁振子模式，通过四波混频使频率梳显著致密化，并使边带数量增加一个数量级。此外，外加面内磁场能够通过移动涡旋核并改变其限域势，连续且可逆地调节频率梳间隔；由孔径引起的几何钉扎还会在相反磁场极性下导致非对称切换和磁滞。我们的结果表明，tMFC 是非线性磁振子学中的一种多用途平台，可用于可调频率梳生成和精密计量。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.19647v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the emergence of twisted magnon frequency combs (tMFCs) and their higher-order modes in ferromagnetic nanorings, arising from strong nonlinear coupling between vortex-core gyration and azimuthal spin-wave modes. The comb lines carry distinct orbital angular momentum with quantum numbers spaced by unity, and their formation obeys selection rules governed by simultaneous conservation of energy and angular momentum. We demonstrate that the hole diameter serves as a powerful tuning parameter: reducing the hole size preserves the conventional tMFC, whereas increasing it introduces an additional magnon mode that dramat?ically densifies the comb via four-wave mixing, boosting the sideband multiplicity by an order of magnitude. Moreover, an external in-plane magnetic field enables continuous, reversible tuning of the comb spacing by dis?placing the vortex core and modifying its confinement potential, with the hole-induced geometric pinning giving rise to asymmetric switching and hysteresis under opposite field polarities. Our results establish the tMFC as a versatile platform for nonlinear magnonics, with potential applications in tunable frequency comb generation and precision metrology.

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.19698v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In magnetic alloys or hybrid systems formed by molecular magnets coupled to a magnetic substrate, the exchange interaction leads to fast spin dynamics after excitation. We investigate the electronic charge and spin dynamics due to the exchange interaction in a two-sublattice system with antiferromagnetic coupling. We employ a simplified model for a ferrimagnetic alloy as a coupled system of itinerant and localized electron states together with an exchange coupling between the two. For the itinerant system we include electron-electron Coulomb scattering and electron-phonon scattering. We study numerically the heat-induced ultrafast magnetization dynamics due to the interplay of exchange scattering and spin-independent scattering processes and discuss different scenarios for the demagnetization and relaxation dynamics of the sublattices. Our results highlight the impact of spin-conserving electron-electron scattering processes on the exchange-driven spin dynamics on ultrashort timescales.

arXiv:2608.19725v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay between altermagnetism and crystalline band topology provides an intriguing avenue for realizing unconventional topological phases with distinctive spin-dependent properties. Here, based on first-principles calculations and theoretical analysis, we identify monolayer Tc₂X₂O (X = Cl, Br) as a family of two-dimensional altermagnetic mirror Chern insulators. In the absence of spin--orbit coupling (SOC), both monolayers exhibit robust altermagnetism with mirror-spin coupling and host two symmetry-protected Weyl points in each spin channel near the Fermi level. The Weyl points in opposite spin channels carry distinct mirror-symmetry eigenvalues, m_z=± i. Upon inclusion of SOC, the Weyl points are gapped, and the two mirror sectors acquire opposite Chern numbers, a̧l C₊=1 and a̧l C₋=-1, resulting in a nonzero mirror Chern number a̧l Cₘ₌₁. A low-energy kḑot p model captures the symmetry protection of the Weyl points and elucidates their SOC-induced mass gaps and topological character. Furthermore, the resulting mirror Chern insulating phases host helical edge states within the bulk band gap and exhibit a quantized spin Hall conductivity. Our work establishes a direct connection between altermagnetism and mirror Chern topology and provides a promising platform for exploring unconventional topological and spin-dependent phenomena in two-dimensional altermagnetic materials.

中文摘要

交替磁体（AM）兼具完全补偿的磁化强度和依赖动量的自旋劈裂，然而具有优异谷特性的本征交替磁性材料仍然十分稀缺。在本文中，我们鉴定出单层钛基硫属化物卤化物 Ti₂X₂Y（X = F、Cl、Br、I；Y = O、S、Se、Te）这一新的二维交替磁性谷材料家族。这些单层材料表现出稳定的 d 波交替磁性序、半导体带隙以及显著的自旋极化谷特性。我们表明，单轴应变能够打破谷简并，诱导巨大的谷极化，并产生可调的压磁响应。面内电场能够产生非共线自旋流，而自旋–轨道耦合则会引起反常霍尔效应、谷选择性线性二色性和磁光克尔效应。这些发现表明，Ti₂X₂Y 单层材料是探索二维交替磁体中自旋依赖和谷依赖电子、光学及输运现象的多用途平台。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.19734v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets (AMs) combine fully compensated magnetization with momentum-dependent spin splitting, yet intrinsic altermagnetic materials exhibiting exceptional valley characteristics remain scarce. Here, we identify monolayer titanium-based chalcogenide halides, Ti₂X₂Y (X = F, Cl, Br, I; Y = O, S, Se, Te), as a new family of two-dimensional altermagnetic valley materials. These monolayers exhibit robust d-wave altermagnetic order, semiconducting band gaps, and pronounced spin-polarized valley characteristics. We show that uniaxial strain breaks the valley degeneracy, inducing giant valley polarization together with a tunable piezomagnetic response. An in-plane electric field generates noncollinear spin currents, while spin--orbit coupling gives rise to the anomalous Hall effect, valley-selective linear dichroism, and the magneto-optical Kerr effect. These findings establish Ti₂X₂Y monolayers as a versatile platform for exploring spin- and valley-dependent electronic, optical, and transport phenomena in two-dimensional altermagnets.

arXiv:2608.19856v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The unexpectedly small ordered moments of CeNiAsO, a candidate for correlated p-wave magnet, have posed a serious challenge to the precise determination of its magnetic structure, hindering the understanding of its fundamental properties. By leveraging the high sensitivity to local internal fields, our ⁷⁵As nuclear quadrupole / magnetic resonance experiments reveal a commensurate antiferromagnetic order with a small out-of-plane moment m_zapprox0.05 μB. This tilted magnetic configuration not only rotates the spin polarization axis away from the crystallographic c-axis, but also enhances the non-relativistic spin splitting. We refer to this rare paradigm as a tilted p-wave magnet.

中文摘要

新兴材料类别中的磁电（ME）现象，例如二维范德华（vdW）磁体和单分子磁体（SMM）中的磁电现象，对下一代低温存储器和量子技术具有巨大潜力。然而，这些体系中的磁电耦合主要在低温下表现出来，因此灵敏且兼容低温环境的磁电表征技术至关重要。为满足这一需求，我们报告了一套基于定制闭循环制冷机的动态锁相磁电耦合测量装置的设计、验证和性能。该装置能够在 20–300 K 的温度范围内、最高 7.5 kOe 的直流磁场下进行测量。我们还介绍了用于减小寄生感应背景信号的关键设计考虑。我们使用 CoFe2O4–BaTiO3（CFO–BTO）颗粒复合材料对该装置进行了验证，重现了具有特征性的室温蝴蝶形磁电回线，其最大磁电系数在约 3 kOe 处达到 0.23 mV/cm-Oe。温度依赖测量分辨出了约 200 K 和 280 K 处的磁电异常，这些异常分别与 BaTiO3 的菱方相–正交相和正交相–四方相结构转变相吻合；同时，在无需重新配置低温恒温器的情况下，对同一样品开展的介电测量也证实了这些异常。该仪器能够可靠地实现低至 20 K 的磁电和介电表征，适用于研究多铁性复合材料和量子材料中的弱磁电耦合及相变。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.19956v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetoelectric (ME) phenomena in emerging material classes, such as two-dimensional van der Waals (vdW) magnets and Single-Molecule Magnets (SMMs), hold immense promise for next-generation cryogenic memory and quantum technologies. However, ME coupling in these systems predominantly manifests at low temperatures, making a sensitive, cryo-compatible ME characterization techniques critical. To address this requirement, we report the design, validation, and performance of a custom closed-cycle refrigerator-based setup for dynamic lock-in ME coupling measurements across 20-300 K under dc magnetic fields up to 7.5 kOe. Key design considerations for mitigating parasitic inductive background signals are also presented. The setup was validated on a CoFe2O4-BaTiO3 (CFO-BTO) particulate composite, reproducing the characteristic room-temperature butterfly ME loop with a maximum ME coefficient value of 0.23 mV/cm-Oe at ~ 3 kOe. Temperature-dependent measurements resolved ME anomalies at ~ 200 K and 280 K, coinciding with the rhombohedral-orthorhombic and orthorhombic-tetragonal structural transitions of BaTiO3, and were corroborated by simultaneous dielectric measurements on the same sample without cryostat reconfiguration. The instrument enables reliable ME and dielectric characterization down to 20 K, making it well suited for probing weak magnetoelectric coupling and phase transitions in multiferroic composites and quantum materials.

中文摘要

Na₃Bi 是一种拓扑狄拉克半金属（TDSM），能够支持双表面费米弧（DSFA）；这种性质对于其材料分类以及在自旋电子器件中的潜在应用都十分重要。然而，表面如何影响真实的 Na₃Bi（100）体系，目前尚不清楚。为研究不同表面对双表面费米弧的影响，我们考虑了两种由第一性原理推导得到的 Na₃Bi（100）终止结构的紧束缚模型。在化学计量终止结构上，我们发现了预期的双表面费米弧。在非化学计量结构上，一个终止面存在双表面费米弧，而另一个终止面出现了两个环，这两个环仍保留了双表面费米弧的许多性质。因此，自旋—动量锁定以及与狄拉克点的杂化等局域性质，似乎比其整体连通性更加稳健。换言之，表面可以重塑费米弧的特征图样，却不会破坏其类费米弧的物理性质。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.20115v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Na₃Bi is a topological Dirac semimetal (TDSM) that can support double surface Fermi arcs (DSFAs), which are important for its material classification and their potential use in spintronic devices. However, it is unclear how the surfaces affect realistic Na₃Bi (100) systems. To investigate the effects of diverse surfaces on DSFAs, we consider first principles derived tight-binding models of two Na₃Bi (100) terminations. On the stoichiometric termination, we find DSFAs as expected. On the non-stoichiometric structure there are DSFAs on one termination and two loops that retain many of the properties of DSFAs. Thus, the local properties such as spin momentum locking and hybridization with the Dirac points appear to be more robust than their global connectivity. That is, the surface can reshape the arc fingerprint without destroying the arc-like physics.

中文摘要

一个具有双阱有效势的量子系统是否会发生自发对称性破缺，不仅取决于势能景观，也取决于动力学以及系统与其他自由度之间的耦合。本文引入一个准精确可解模型，在铁电体背景下研究这一问题，其结果适用于一大类量子相变。利用解析解，我们严格定义了量子顺电区域，并确定了一种不同的量子铁电区域，在该区域中，即使不存在隧穿特征，也可以实现对称性破缺。随后我们证明，显式对称性破缺不能仅由序参量哈密顿量本身推断出来，而必须引入额外耦合。这使我们确定了一个量子耗散顺电性区域：在向基态演化的过程中，即使双阱结构相对于零点量子涨落占主导地位，可观测的对称性破缺仍会受到抑制。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.20168v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Whether a quantum system with a double-well effective potential undergoes spontaneous symmetry breaking depends not only on the potential landscape but also on the kinetics and the coupling with additional degrees of freedom. Here we introduce a quasi-exactly solvable model to study this problem in the context of ferroelectrics, with results that apply to a broad class of quantum phase transitions. Exploiting the analytical solutions, we provide a strict definition of the quantum paraelectric regime and identify a distinct quantum ferroelectric regime in which symmetry breaking can be realized without tunneling features. We then show that explicit symmetry breaking cannot be inferred from the order-parameter Hamiltonian alone, but requires additional couplings. This leads us to identify a regime of emphquantum dissipative paraelectricity, in which observable symmetry breaking is suppressed during the evolution toward the ground state, even when the double-well structure dominates over zero-point quantum fluctuations.

在（1+1）维伊辛临界性附近，磁场扰动会诱导禁闭，并产生一系列被称为介子的束缚态激发。本文表明，在分别对模型依赖的微观耦合进行重标度之后，这些介子具有普适的质量标度关系。稳定介子的数量由最低的双介子阈值控制，而最低介子的质量沿一条由单一标度参数刻画的连续轨迹变化。我们采用哈密顿量截断方法，在伊辛场论和近临界混合场伊辛链（MFIC）中数值获得了这条轨迹。在重标度之后，MFIC 的轨迹以及稳定介子数目的交叉窗口都塌缩到场论结果上。为进一步展示介子谱的上述普适组织结构，我们考察了一类具有四周期结构、处于横向场中的自旋 1/2 海森堡—伊辛链；其参数空间包含一族量子伊辛临界点。这族哈密顿量包括准一维反铁磁体 Ba(Sr)Co₂V₂O₈ 的有效自旋模型。利用张量网络计算，我们获得了 BaCo₂V₂O₈ 中最低介子的质量轨迹，并发现它同样塌缩到由场论结果给出的同一条普适曲线上。我们的结果表明，量子伊辛临界性的普适标度结构可以延伸到邻近的禁闭区域，并支配介子谱的组织方式。因此，这些结果为解释混合场中类伊辛准一维磁体的激发提供了一个实用判据，其适用范围超越了 E₈ 可积性情形。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.20221v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Near (1+1)-dimensional [(1+1)D] Ising criticality, a magnetic perturbation induces confinement and produces a cascade of bound-state excitations known as mesons. Here we show these mesons share a universal mass scaling after independently rescaling the model-dependent microscopic couplings. The number of stable mesons is controlled by the lightest two-meson threshold, while the lightest-meson mass follows a continuous trajectory characterized by a single scaling parameter. Using Hamiltonian truncation method, we obtain the trajectory numerically in both Ising field theory and the near-critical mixed-field Ising chain (MFIC). Under the rescaling, the trajectory and stable-meson-count crossover windows of MFIC both collapse onto the field-theory results. To further demonstrate the above universal organization of the meson spectra, we consider a class of four-periodic spin-1/2 Heisenberg-Ising chains under transverse fields, whose parameter space contains a family of quantum Ising critical points. The Hamiltonian family includes effective spin models for the quasi-one-dimensional antiferromagnets Ba(Sr)Co₂V₂O₈. Using tensor-network calculations, we obtain the corresponding lightest-meson mass trajectory for BaCo₂V₂O₈ and find that it also collapse onto the same universal curve given by field-theory result. Our results suggest that the universal scaling structure of quantum Ising criticality extends into the nearby confining regime, governing the organization of the meson spectrum. They thereby provide a practical criterion for interpreting excitations of quasi-1D Ising-like magnets in mixed fields beyond E₈ integrability.

中文摘要

有机晶体管在神经形态应用中正发挥日益重要的作用。然而，仅依赖铁电切换或界面陷阱来实现多电导态的器件，其记忆窗口受到限制。本文在薄膜晶体管结构中，于聚合物半导体与铁电介质的界面处引入一个含有均匀分布亚纳米铂纳米颗粒（PtNP）的超薄氧化物层。Al₂O₃/PtNP/Al₂O₃ 界面堆叠结构为局域电荷俘获和释放提供了可行途径，并且这一过程发生在能够最有效影响沟道电导的区域。有机晶体管在电流—电压特性中表现出较大的记忆窗口（大于 20 V）。亚纳米 PtNP 产生了与室温类库仑阻塞输运相一致的特征，支持记忆窗口内离散且彼此分离的能级。器件支持利用电刺激和光刺激进行多模式编程，同时表现出长期可塑性和增强的短期可塑性（STP）现象。这些结果为在神经形态计算发展中实现短期可塑性开辟了新的方向。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.20245v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Organic transistors are playing an increasingly important role for neuromorphic applications. However, devices that rely solely on ferroelectric switching or on interface traps for their multi-conductance states exhibit limited memory windows. Here, we introduce an ultrathin oxide layer with a uniform distribution of sub-nm platinum nanoparticles (PtNPs) at the interface of a polymer semiconducting and a ferroelectric dielectric in a thin film transistor architecture. The interfacial stack, Al₂O₃/PtNP/Al₂O₃, provides a viable route for localized charge trapping and de-trapping in a region where it can most effectively influence the channel conductance. The organic transistors display a large memory window (> 20 V) in their current-voltage characteristics. The sub-nm PtNPs give rise to features that are consistent with room temperature Coulomb blockade-like transport, supporting discrete and well-separated levels within the memory window. The devices support multimodal programming using electrical and optical stimuli with both long-term plasticity and enhanced short-term plasticity (STP) phenomena. These results open new directions for implementing STP in the development of neuromorphic computing.

arXiv:2608.20323v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We analyze the performance of a spin-torque microwave detector (STMD) driven by positive rectangular current pulses I(t) of various amplitudes I₀, durations τ, and repetition periods T and reveal two distinct regimes of STMD operation. In the first (linear) regime, the time-averaged voltage across the detector, Uₘ̊ dc, changes linearly with the pulse amplitude I₀ and depends on the ratio τ/T: Uₘ̊ dc sim I₀ (τ/T). This regime is observed for a wide range of pulse amplitudes I₀ in the case of in-plane (IP) magnetization dynamics and for rather small pulse amplitudes I₀ łe Iₘ̊ ₜₕ in an STMD with out-of-plane (OOP) magnetization dynamics. The other (nonlinear) regime is characterized by voltage jumps and drops and is observed only in a structure with OOP magnetization dynamics for input pulses with short repetition periods and large amplitudes I₀ ge Iₘ̊ ₜₕ. We believe that the linear regime of STMD operation can be used to unambiguously detect input pulse parameters, which could be important for the development and optimization of spintronic devices capable of detecting and processing non-harmonic (e.g., digital) microwave signals.

中文摘要

开壳层纳米石墨烯为在其π共轭网络中承载非常规磁态提供了一个通用平台。特别有吸引力的是包含空间分离自由基和可调相互作用的石墨烯结构，它们为基于自旋的量子架构提供了一条可扩展途径。三角烯非常适合这一目的，因为其自由基数量随尺寸缩放，尽管强杂化会阻碍单个自旋控制。在这里，我们实现了一种自由基重构策略，通过以长度逐渐增加的扶手椅型蒽烯单元对单自由基氮杂三角烯进行共价延伸，将其转化为三个拓扑保护自旋态。扫描隧道谱揭示了新出现的关联自旋，它们形成一个受挫自旋三聚体，其相互作用随蒽烯长度增加而减弱。多参考电子结构计算捕捉到了这一趋势，这些计算追踪到多自由基特征逐步增强，而这种增强由关联前线轨道逐步重组为三个边缘局域自然轨道所驱动。因此，初始的单自由基双重态重组为非相互作用的边缘自旋，成为三量子比特量子寄存器的分子模拟物。

English Abstract

arXiv:2512.10869v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Open-shell nanographenes provide a versatile platform to host unconventional magnetic states within their π-conjugated networks. Particularly appealing are graphene architectures that incorporate spatially separated radicals and tunable interactions, offering a scalable route toward spin-based quantum architectures. Triangulenes are ideal for this purpose, as their radical count scales with size, although strong hybridization prevents individual spin control. Here, we realize a radical reconfiguration strategy that transforms a single-radical aza-triangulene into three topologically protected spin states by covalently extending it with armchair anthene moieties of increasing length. Scanning tunnelling spectroscopy reveals emergent correlated spins forming a frustrated spin trimer whose interaction weakens with anthene length. This trend is captured by multi-reference electronic-structure calculations, which trace a progressive rise in polyradical character driven by the progressive reorganization of the correlated frontier orbitals into three edge-localized natural orbitals. Consequently, the initial single-radical doublet reorganizes into non-interacting edge spins, a molecular analog of a three-qubit quantum register.

中文摘要

arXiv:2603.11555v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们在顺磁相内采用 DFT+DMFT 方法研究了单层 Fe₃GeTe₂ 的电子和磁性性质。我们认为该化合物距离局域磁矩极限足够远，并在较宽温度范围内表现出部分逆局域磁化率和均匀磁化率的非线性温度依赖。我们发现，在中等库仑相互作用强度（U=3-4 eV）下，位于 Ge 平面上方和下方的铁原子携带显著的局域磁矩（μ gtrsim 4.5 μ_B），而位于 Ge 平面内的铁原子则不表现出明显的磁矩。同时，这两类对称性不等价原子之间的 RKKY 型交换相互作用对于稳定 Fe₃GeTe₂ 中的长程铁磁有序至关重要。估算得到的自旋波刚度和居里温度与实验数据符合良好，这表明对 Fe₃GeTe₂ 中电子关联进行动力学处理对于正确描述其部分巡游的磁性行为是必不可少的。

English Abstract

arXiv:2603.11555v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the electronic and magnetic properties of monolayer Fe₃GeTe₂ within the DFT+DMFT approach in the paramagnetic phase. We argue that this compound is sufficiently far from the local magnetic moment limit, demonstrating non-linear temperature dependencies of the partial inverse local and uniform magnetic susceptibilities in a broad temperature range. We find that in the regime of moderate Coulomb interactions (U=3-4 eV), the iron atoms located above and below the Ge plane carry a substantial local magnetic moment (μ gtrsim 4.5 μ_B), while the iron atom located within the Ge plane does not exhibit any pronounced magnetic moment. At the same time, the RKKY-type exchange interactions between these two symmetry-nonequivalent types of atoms turn out to be crucial for stabilizing long-range ferromagnetic order in Fe₃GeTe₂. The estimated spin-wave stiffness and Curie temperature are in good agreement with the experimental data, indicating that a dynamical treatment of electron correlations in Fe₃GeTe₂ is essential to properly describe its partially itinerant magnetic behavior.

arXiv:2606.11862v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们研究了一个由晶格正则化 Bernevig--Hughes--Zhang 模型描述的二维补偿型 (d) 波交替磁体中的电可控 Chern 拓扑。在交替磁参考态中，两个 Kramers 扇区获得依赖动量的自旋分裂和相反的扇区 Chern 数，而组合的 C₄zmathcal T 对称性强制总电荷 Chern 数为零。我们表明，这种隐藏的拓扑结构可以通过轨道选择性的磁耦合被激活，并可由铁电轨道杂化独立调控。磁耦合消除了扇区间的抵消并生成 C=±1 和 ±2 相，而极性畸变将狄拉克能隙闭合点从高对称动量处移开，从而实现诸如 C=0→-1 和 C=1→2 的电学转变。所得各相表现出预期的手性边缘态数目及量子化反常霍尔电导。其拓扑性还通过能隙内关系 ∂_μ widetilde M_z=-C 反映在轨道磁化中。最后，我们表明，这些 Chern 相对于横向 Kramers 扇区混合以及允许对称��的反演非对称自旋--轨道耦合仍保持鲁棒。上述结果为在补偿型交替磁体中实现电可调 Chern 绝缘相建立了一条基于对称性的途径。

English Abstract

arXiv:2606.11862v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate electrically controllable Chern topology in a two-dimensional compensated (d)-wave altermagnet described by a lattice-regularized Bernevig--Hughes--Zhang model. In the altermagnetic reference state, the two Kramers sectors acquire momentum-dependent spin splitting and opposite sector Chern numbers, while the combined C₄zmathcal T symmetry enforces a vanishing total charge Chern number. We show that this hidden topological structure can be activated by orbital-selective magnetic coupling and independently tuned by ferroelectric orbital hybridization. The magnetic coupling removes the sector cancellation and generates C=±1 and ±2 phases, whereas the polar distortion shifts the Dirac gap closing away from high-symmetry momenta and enables electrical transitions such as C=0i̊ghtarrow-1 and C=1i̊ghtarrow2. The resulting phases exhibit the expected chiral edge-state multiplicity and quantized anomalous Hall conductivity. Their topology is further reflected in the orbital magnetization through the in-gap relation partial_μ widetilde M_z=-C. Finally, we show that the Chern phases remain robust against transverse Kramers-sector mixing and symmetry-allowed inversion-asymmetric spin--orbit coupling. These results establish a symmetry-based route to electrically tunable Chern insulating phases in compensated altermagnets.

arXiv:2607.06159v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We predict that intercalating bilayer graphene with nonmagnetic WSSe or magnetic MnSSe Janus monolayers induces a layer-selective switch of the in-plane Rashba spin texture, resulting in opposite spin current directions in the top and bottom graphene layers. Tight-binding modeling of the proximitized layers, combined with Rashba-Edelstein charge-to-spin conversion calculations, confirms that the spin current direction can be independently controlled by gating the top or bottom graphene layer. Bilayer graphene intercalated by Janus monolayers thus represents a promising platform for gate-tunable, layer-selective spintronic devices.

arXiv:2607.06730v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：尽管异常霍尔效应曾被提出为交变磁体的输运指纹，但其本质上来源于自旋轨道耦合诱导的净磁化，对应于一种称为自旋轨道磁性的不同磁相。然而，尽管净磁化极小，自旋轨道磁体仍能产生显著异常霍尔响应的微观机制仍不明确。本文采用定向自旋群理论和自旋轨道耦合张量展开，系统地厘清了交变磁体中轨道磁化与自旋磁化相对于自旋轨道耦合的微扰行为。值得注意的是，我们发现，只有当反平行自旋子晶格通过四重旋转连接时，轨道磁化与自旋磁化才表现出不同的微扰阶次。在这类交变磁体中，我们进一步发现一种共轴霍尔效应，其特征是诱导的自旋磁化和轨道磁化与 Néel 矢量平行排列；我们还通过对交变磁体 KV₂Se₂O 的第一性原理计算验证了这一点。该效应为在弱外场下实现 Néel 序的确定性切换提供了很大潜力。我们的工作提供了一种系统的对称性方法，用于识别可能兼具强异常霍尔效应与极小净磁化的交变磁体候选材料，为高性能、无杂散场自旋电子学应用铺平了道路。

English Abstract

arXiv:2607.06730v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: While the anomalous Hall effect was proposed as a transport fingerprint of altermagnets, it originates from the spin-orbit coupling-induced net magnetization, corresponding to a distinct magnetic phase termed spin-orbit magnetism. However, the microscopic mechanism enabling spin-orbit magnets to yield a prominent anomalous Hall response despite a vanishingly small net magnetization remains elusive. Here, by employing oriented spin group theory and spin-orbit-coupling tensor expansion, we systematically disentangle the perturbative behaviors of orbital and spin magnetizations with respect to spin-orbit coupling in altermagnets. Remarkably, we find that only if the opposite-spin sublattices are connected through a fourfold rotation, the orbital and spin magnetizations exhibit distinct perturbative orders. In these altermagnets, we further discover a coaxial Hall effect characterized by the induced spin and orbital magnetizations aligning parallel to the Néel vector, which we further demonstrate by first-principles calculations in the altermagnet KV₂Se₂O. This effect holds great promise for achieving deterministic switching of the Néel order under weak external fields. Our work provides a systematic symmetry approach to identify potential altermagnetic candidates combining a large anomalous Hall effect with minimal net magnetization, paving the way for high-performance, stray-field-free spintronic applications.

arXiv:2607.18986v3
公告类型：替换
摘要：化学家通过建立在成对交换耦合 J 之上的结构-性质关系来设计磁��材料，如今这些 J 通常可通过能量映射由第一性原理常规提取。然而，只要四个磁中心围成一个回路——如铜酸盐 CuO₂ 平面或无限层方形网格中那样——就可能出现四自旋环交换 Jᵣᵢₙg，它会重塑基态并污染用于设计的 J 值。此前缺少一种像四态方法对 J 那样，能够直接、局域地获得 Jᵣᵢₙg 的方法。我们通过将该方法推广到十六态（2⁴）方案来提供这一手段，并将其自动化实现于开源 Mag4 软件包中，这是四态家族的首个自动化实现。只需一个 cif 文件，Mag4 就能提出隔离这些耦合所需的超胞，按用户选定的泛函生成 DFT 输入，结合带隙和局域磁矩诊断提取 J 与 Jᵣᵢₙg，并预测磁序、传播矢量和临界温度。对称性将十六种构型化简为六个或八个不等价能量，因此计算成本适中。推导表明，传统的四态 J 本身就被环交换重整化了 ±2 Jᵣᵢₙg S²，符号由参考态决定。T 型 La2CuO4 验证了这一点：三种途径对 Jᵣᵢₙg 的结果一致到 0.2%，得到 Jᵣᵢₙg/J1 = 0.25，而未注明参考态的四态 J1 误差达 12%。十六态结果本身也依赖参考态——奈尔态与铁磁背景给出了上下界——这是超出“成对项加环项”模型之外相互作用的四阶指纹；通过进一步改变背景，可将其分解为裸的 Jᵣᵢₙg，以及一个逐渐收敛的六自旋和八自旋环交换层级。SrFeO2（S=2）具有相同的四方晶格，却有 Jᵣᵢₙg/J = 0.006，是一个负对照：四方晶格是环交换的必要条件，但远非充分条件，这为筛选新的多自旋磁体提供了结构-性质判据。

English Abstract

arXiv:2607.18986v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Chemists design magnetic materials through structure-property relationships built on pairwise exchange couplings J, now extracted routinely from first principles by energy-mapping. But wherever four magnetic centers close a loop---as in cuprate CuO₂ planes or infinite-layer square nets---a four-spin ring exchange Jₘ̊ ᵣᵢₙg can arise, reshaping ground states and corrupting the J values used for design. Missing has been a direct, local way to obtain it, as the four-state method gives for J. We supply it by generalizing that method to a sixteen-state (2⁴⁾ scheme, automated in the open Mag4 package---the first automatic implementation of the four-state family. From one cif file, Mag4 proposes the supercell that isolates the couplings, generates DFT inputs in the user's chosen functional, extracts J and Jₘ̊ ᵣᵢₙg with band-gap and local-moment diagnostics, and predicts the magnetic order, propagation vector, and critical temperature. Symmetry reduces the sixteen configurations to six or eight inequivalent energies, so the cost is modest. The derivation shows the conventional four-state J is itself ring-renormalized by mp 2 Jₘ̊ ᵣᵢₙg S², the sign set by the reference state. T-La₂CuO₄ confirms this: three routes agree on Jₘ̊ ᵣᵢₙg to 0.2%, giving Jₘ̊ ᵣᵢₙg/J₁₌₀.25, and a four-state J₁ quoted without its reference is wrong by 12%. The sixteen-state value is itself reference-dependent---Néel and ferromagnetic baths bracket it---a fourth-order fingerprint of interactions beyond the pair-plus-ring model, resolved by further baths into a bare Jₘ̊ ᵣᵢₙg and a converging tower of six- and eight-spin loop couplings. SrFeO₂ (S=2), same plaquette yet Jₘ̊ ᵣᵢₙg/J=0.006, is the negative control: a plaquette is necessary for ring exchange but far from sufficient---a structure-property criterion for screening new multi-spin magnets.

摘要：激子凝聚态为研究准粒子配对、玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚-巴丁-库珀-施里弗（BEC-BCS）交叉以及激子拓扑现象提供了一个平台。实现非平衡激子凝聚态能够使这些涌现现象达到极致可调。尽管如此，光诱导的非平衡激子凝聚态及其 BEC-BCS 交叉的证据仍然难以捉摸。在此，我们利用时间分辨和角分辨光电子能谱，证明了单层 MnBi2Te4 中非平衡激子凝聚态及其 BEC-BCS 交叉的特征。光激发后，出现了一种代表激子的独特空穴型色散，并持续超过 20 ps。值得注意的是，价带中的能量域锐化在零时刻后 2 ps 出现，并在泵浦通量阈值 0.84 mJ/cm2 处表现出突发式起始。这种延迟且强非线性的响应难以用瞬态场效应或常规载流子诱导的能带位移来解释，但与由 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless 转变支配的激子凝聚模型相一致。估算得到的阈值激子密度与 Nelson-Kosterlitz 临界密度定量一致。在更高通量下，激子特征发展为驼峰状色散，这与凝聚态框架中的 BEC-BCS 交叉一致。我们的工作将超薄 MnBi2Te4 确立为研究非平衡激子凝聚态的模型体系，并揭示其与超导性及激子驱动拓扑相之间的联系。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.20310v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exciton condensates provide a platform to study quasiparticle pairing, Bose-Einstein condensation-Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BEC-BCS) crossover, and excitonic topological phenomena. Achieving a nonequilibrium exciton condensate allows the ultimate tunability of these emergent phenomena. Yet, evidence of a light-induced, nonequilibrium exciton condensate and its BEC-BCS crossover remains elusive. Here, we use time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy to demonstrate signatures of a non-equilibrium exciton condensate and its BEC-BCS crossover in monolayer MnBi2Te4. Following optical excitation, a distinctive hole-like dispersion representing excitons emerges and persists for >20 ps. Strikingly, energy-domain sharpening in the valence band occurs 2 ps after time zero and exhibits a sharp onset at a threshold pump fluence of 0.84 mJ/cm2. The delayed and strongly nonlinear response is difficult to reconcile with transient field effects or conventional carrier-induced band shifts but is consistent with a model of exciton condensation governed by a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transition. The estimated threshold exciton density agrees quantitatively with the Nelson-Kosterlitz critical density. At higher fluences, the exciton feature develops a camel-back-shaped dispersion, consistent with the BEC-BCS crossover in the condensate framework. Our work establishes ultrathin MnBi2Te4 as a model system for studying nonequilibrium exciton condensates with a connection to superconductivity and exciton-driven topological phases.

交错磁体兼具反铁磁性与铁磁有序的特征。在此，作者将Co₁/₄TaSe₂确定为一种层状交错磁材料，并展示了费米面上交错磁自旋分裂的清晰特征。

English Abstract

Altermagnetism is a magnetic phase combining characteristics of both antiferromagnetism and ferromagnetic ordering. Despite growing theoretical interest in altermagnetic materials, reports of experimentally verified high-Néel temperature layered compounds are limited or remain to be firmly established. Here, we present an angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy and density functional theory study of Co1/4TaSe2, a compound we identify as a layered altermagnetic material. Magnetic susceptibility measurements confirm type-A antiferromagnetic ordering with a Néel temperature of 178 K. Our spin-resolved and spin-integrated angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy measurements reveal an electronic band structure in excellent agreement with density functional theory calculations, demonstrating clear signatures of altermagnetic spin splitting at the Fermi surface. Furthermore, temperature-dependent angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy reveals a reconstructed valence band structure, with observable band shifts upon heating above the Néel temperature, consistent with the suppression of altermagnetic order. These findings establish Co1/4TaSe2as a promising platform for exploring altermagnetic phenomena.

中文摘要

铁电性与金属导电性的相互排斥是一个长期存在的基本认识，因为巡游电子会屏蔽稳定体相极性有序所需的长程库仑力。在此，我们通过对一种非极性共价半导体立方碳化硅（3C-SiC）进行氮重掺杂，打破了这一范式。该掺杂引入了大量电子，使材料产生金属性，并通过拟 Jahn-Teller 效应驱动结构从非极性F-43m对称性转变为极性R3m对称性。值得注意的是，我们在外加电压偏置下直接以原子尺度观察到了铁电金属中约180°的极化反转。导电电子所占据的反键轨道具有很强的方向性，使其无法屏蔽局域的Si-C极化，从而实现了金属性与铁电性的共存。铁电隧道结表现出非易失存储特性，具有明确的高电阻态（HRS）和低电阻态（LRS）、超高响应速度（约50 ns）、超低工作电压（1 V）、超过85927次的耐久性以及预计100年的保持时间。我们的结果为在金属中开创铁电性提供了新的策略，为探索奇异性质提供了新的铁电金属平台，并构建了一种高性能铁电器件，满足低功耗和高速非易失器件的需求。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.18189v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The mutual exclusion of ferroelectricity and metallic conductivity is a long-standing tenet because itinerant electrons screen long-range Coulomb forces that stabilize the bulk polar order. Here, we break this paradigm by heavily doping a non-polar covalent semiconductor of cubic silicon carbide (3C-SiC) with nitrogen. This introduces heavy electron doping, inducing metallicity and driving a structural transition from the non-polar F-43m to the polar R3m symmetry via the pseudo-Jahn-Teller effect. Remarkably, we provide direct, atomic-scale visualization of about 180deg polarization reversal under an external voltage bias in a ferroelectric metal. The strongly directional character of antibonding orbitals occupied by conduction electrons prevents them from screening the local Si-C polarization, resulting in the coexistence of metallicity and ferroelectricity. Ferroelectric tunnel junctions demonstrate nonvolatile memory properties with a well-defined high-resistance state (HRS) and low-resistance state (LRS), an ultrahigh response speed (~50 ns), an ultralow operating voltage (1 V), an endurance exceeding 85927 cycles, and a projected retention time of 100 years. Our results provide a novel strategy for pioneering ferroelectricity in a metal, a new ferroelectric metal platform for exploring exotic properties, and a ferroelectric device with high performance that meets the requirements for low consumption and high-speed non-volatile devices.

中文摘要

斯格明子是二维磁体中有望用于非易失、低功耗和高密度自旋电子存储器的候选对象。然而，由于难以构建所需的手性磁相互作用，在二维极限下实现斯格明子仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们利用同步辐射X射线光电子发射电子显微镜和扫描氮-空位磁力计，在Janus二维铬硫属化物中实现了尼尔型斯格明子的产生和直接成像；这些斯格明子表现出无外场稳定性、非易失性和尺寸可调性。第一性原理计算和微磁模拟表明，Janus表面诱导的反演对称性破缺增强了Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用，为斯格明子的稳定和可调控性提供了微观机制。我们进一步在低至300 Oe的磁场下，利用单个超快激光脉冲实现了斯格明子的可逆写入和擦除，展示了这一二维磁性系统出色的操控能力。这些结果确立了Janus工程作为在原子级薄磁体中产生和操控非易失斯格明子的一种途径，并对基于斯格明子的低功耗自旋电子器件具有重要意义。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.18278v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Skyrmions in 2D magnets are promising candidates for nonvolatile, low-power, and high-density spintronic memories. However, their experimental realization at the 2D limit remains challenging, owing to the difficulty in engineering the required chiral magnetic interactions. Here, we report the creation and direct imaging of Néel-type skyrmions in Janus 2D chromium chalcogenides using synchrotron X-ray photoemission electron microscopy, and scanning nitrogen-vacancy magnetometry, which exhibit field-free stability, nonvolatility, and size tunability. First-principles calculations and micromagnetic simulations reveal that Janus-surface-induced inversion-symmetry breaking enhances the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction, providing the microscopic mechanism for skyrmion stabilization and tunability. We further achieve reversible skyrmion writing and erasing using a single ultrafast laser pulse in a magnetic field as low as 300 Oe, demonstrating the excellent manipulability of this 2D magnetic system. These results establish Janus engineering as a route to creating and manipulating nonvolatile skyrmions in atomically thin magnets, with implications for skyrmion-based low-power spintronic devices.
